tei:div.tei:p: — — ——— ———————— ྈrdosdu ri pho+otre+o// da ba( bhekhaṃ/ —rtsa ba' 'a/prelta/ 1 pa/ci / mesakha r+ṣa ba bapya) ( 'a/snye lakha tsheྈskyi /lge( derne3 gu — ltarkasgri 1 shi rke tre( pya pho/kabyang ba rnam rgyal grags bzang /ri rī sdu —dwo k+ṣiṃ /rtse pre rī/ri codī germe) ṭā snye waci—nyu — lngel+leji4 rdo sna) ḍa r+sharngo) 〉 1/ /1dzo rngo//1 kāriḍarme ri — rīrīri lke ( —rdo ṇa—kle tswashābyekā hūṃrdzotshodā— sna—— — —sdukyi/ rdori sho/ jiX rdzosko shrī po —tram̐ byāky-i dīskre ༷ — riri7 sne ‘po k+ṣ-i/ tsho /༵‘ ḍārdo ༷༷pro0 ——d+nghaditsho1( lja—ོlha/ts+tsharichiciji sne—dze—rangh+ru mirti sna(((4kāphyo dzetsho—(rdoprek+shispra — — ( ༄ cistotre geskeji(lha gartse ཿskung—
r+ṣa d+dhasgo

sngon 'gro'i gtam/bod kyi gso ba rig pa la lo ngo bzhi stong la nye ba'i lo rgyus ldan la/ de ni gna' bo'i bod kyi gso rig rmang gzhir byas thog rgya gar rgya nag ta zig la sogs pa'i gso ba rig pa'i nying bcud bsdu len byas nas grub pa zhig yin la/gzhung lugs kyi ma lag cha tshang zhing lag len gyi myong byang phun sum tshogs pa dang / mi rigs kyi khyad chos mngon par bkra ba'i gso dpyad kyi rig pa zhig yin pas na/ snga mo zhig nas 'dzam gling khyab khongs kyi gso rig smra ba rnams kyis gdeng 'jog chen po gnang mus su mchis/bod kyi gso ba rig pa la gzhung dang lag len gyi bstan bcos bgrang las 'das pa zhig yod pa ste/ de ni nang don gyi thad gso rig lo rgyus dang /rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs/ nad thog lag len/ sman rdzas sdeb bzo/ lus khams bde srung la sogs rig tshan yongs su 'dus yod pa'i nor bu'i bang mdzod cig lags/ de la tang dang srid gzhung gi thugs 'khur dang brtsi mthong chen po'i 'og nye lor bod kyi gso ba rig pa rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel gang legs byung yod la/ gna' gzhung gang mang zhig kyang dpe skrun 'grems spel byas zin yod/ yin na yang da dung gna' dpe mang po zhig sngar bzhin 'bus zos rul gog thebs pa'am/ yang na mi'i rtsol ba'i dbang gis gtor brlag tshabs chen thebs kyi yod pas/ gang myur sgos srung skyob ma byas tshe rin thang gzhal du med pa'i gna' dpe gang mang zhig rtsa brlag rgyun chad du 'gro nyen che/ de la bod kyi gso ba rig pa nyid phyogs yongs nas rgyun 'dzin dang dar 1

spel gtong rgyu'i dmigs yul bcangs nas nga tshos 20rkya2lor mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang gis gtso khrid byas pa'i ‘‘〈bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe tshogs〉rtsom sgrig tshogs pa ’’sgrig 'dzugs byas pa dang / gna' dpe 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig dang rtsom sgrig bcas kyi las sgo phye zhing dpe skrun dang 'grems spel gyi bya ba yang 'go brtsams zin yod/ dpe tshogs 'di ni snga na ma mchis pa'i rig gnas kyi las grwa chen po zhig yin la/ 'di nyid bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe yod do cog 'dus pa'i dpe tshogs shig tu 'gyur bar byed rgyu ni nga tsho'i bsam 'dun yin la/ de ltar byed thub pa'i yid ches kyang nga tshor yod/de ltar dpe tshogs 'di thog mar dpe skrun byed pa'i sgo dang bstun nas 'dir kho bos bya bzhag chen po 'di phyogs gang thad nas bya ba lam lhong yong ba'i bkra shis smon 'dun zhu rgyu dang / de bzhin bod kyi gso ba rig pa la lhag bsam dkar ba'i yul dang phyogs so so'i skyes bu kun nas kyang las grwa 'dir phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor dang rogs 'degs byed pa'i bsam 'dun zhu rgyu yin/zhes 'o tshogs chen nas/2rkyaskyu4lo'i zla 2par/2

mtshams smyor ba'i gtam/kha ba ri bo'i bcu phrag rig gnas zhes bya ba ni bod mi rigs kyis 'jig rtenaspyi'i phan bde gzhi mar gyur pa'i blo'i rig pa mtha' dag spyi la btags pa'i ming zhig yin la/ de las gzhan rjes 'dzin gyi thabs mchog dam par gyur pa'i gangs can gso ba rig pa ni bod mi rigs rang nyid kyis srol rgyun dar spel mdzad cing 'gro ba mi'i rigs la phan pa 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i rig pa zhig yin stabs/ ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs la phan pa'i las don kho na sgrub pa'i rig pa zhig tu 'khums shing spyi tshogs dang dus rabs ji 'dra zhig gi nang du'ang mkho gal dang phan thogs che ba zhig yin pa ni don dngos kyi steng nas grub pa'i gnas lugs shig yin pas mi su dang su zhig gis kyang bsnyon 'ding dang khyog bshad bya bar mi nus so/ / rang re'i lo rgyus yig tshang dang da yod bstan bcos kyi dkar chag ltar na/ g.yung drung bon lugs kyi drang srong dpyad bu khri shes nas sman pa dung gi thor cog can bar dang / rje btsun g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon po nas gter ston gra ba mngon shes kyi bar/ be+e ro tsa na nas lo chen rin chen bzang po'i skabs/ byang zur rnam gnyis nas kong sprul yab sras/ mi dbang sde srid rin po che nas sman rtsis mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu la thug pa'i rgang srong mkhas grub rim byon bgrang gis mi langs pa rnams kyi sku drin las/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dgongs 'grel dang yan lag brgyad pa'i dgongs 'grel gtso byas pa'i gso rig gi bstan bcos ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam pa rang gis mjal na dad pa'i 1

spu long g.yo zhing gzhan la ngom na la rgya'i spobs pa rgyas pa 'dis bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i lo rgyus ring la gzhung man ngag gi nang don phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin pa ra sprod gsal po byas 'duga'on kyang mig sngar phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen du ma'i dbang gis rang re'i gso rig thad kyi gzhung man ngag gi gdams pa mang po zhig nyams nyes su gyur dang 'gyur mus yin pa'ang kun gyis mkhyen gsal lags pas/ da lta'i dus 'dir bdag cag tshe rig 'dzin pa rnams kyis tshong zong kho na dang yul lung bye brag pa'i khe phan nam phyogs ris can gyi lta ba sogs ring du dor nas mi rigs kyi rig gnas yid bzhin nor bu lta bu 'di la snying khong nas sha tsha dang gces spras/ de bzhin ris su med pa'i 'dzam gling gi mi'i rigs yongs la phan du re ba'i kun slong rnam dag gi sgo nas/ ri rgyal lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i bod lugs gso rig gi gzhung man ngag rnams la 'ol tshod dang rang bzo tsam ma yin par sngar las lhag pa'i ngang sngog 'don myur skyob dang 'tshol sdud legs sgrig byed rgyu bcas ni shin tu gal gnad che ba'i bgyi ba zhig red//de'i phyir mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang gis ming don mtshungs pa'i sgo nas bod kyi sman rtsis rig pa rgyud 'dzin yag po zhig dang gsar btod gong spel gyi rmang gzhi brtan po zhig 'dzugs thub pa'i ched du/da lta'i dus rabs dang srid jus bzang po'i go skabs dam 'dzin ngang mi dngos nor gsum gyi stobs shugs gcig tu bsgril zhing mig rgyang ring ba'i jus gzhi dang bcas te rang re'i sman rtsis skor gyi mkho gal che ba'i gna' dpe dang bstan bcos lag tu zin to cog phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par du bskrun pa'i dge ba 'dis/ da lta tsam ma zad 'byung 'gyur bod kyi sman rtsis bstan pa nyid yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro bar bsam yul las 'das pa'i 2

nus pa thon thub cing lus can kun gyi srog 'tsho'i dpal du 'gyur bar gdon mi za bas na/ 'o skol thun mong gis rjes su yi rang zhu 'os pa'i las don gal chen zhig red ces ha cang dga' tshor dang bcas mtshams spyor ba'i tshig tu/6)khro ru tshe rnam gyis/spyi lo 2002lo'i zla 11tshes 1nyin la/

dag sgrig pa'i gsal bshad/bod zal mo sgang ba zhes su grags pa 'dzam gling gi yang steng du gnas pa'i mi rigs nyid la gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i sngon byon dran dbang dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin las/ dam pa'i chos kyis gtsos pa'i bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyis yongs su phyug pa'i shes rig bang mdzod ni srid pa'i mthar yang nub pa med pa zhig mchis pa la sus kyang bsnyon du med do// de las gnas bcu'i ya gyal gzhan rjes 'dzin gyi thabs mchog dam par gyur pa'i bod kyi gso ba rig pa ni/ rje g.yu thog chen pos/ mi na bar gnas par 'dod pa dang na ba gso bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o zhes gsungs pa bzhin ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs la phan pa 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i rig pa zhig ste/ der lo rgyus kyi dus yun ha cang ring zhing gzhung lugs kyi ma lag cha tshang yin pa ma zad/ sman dpyad kyi rigs lam khyad du 'phags shing man ngag nyams myong phun sum tshogs shing gya nom pa zhig mchis stabs/ deng skabs rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu tshan —rig pa mkhas can dag gis phyogs yongs nas slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug gi gom stabs mgyogs len byed bzhin pa dang / rang re'i rgyal khab nas kyang tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'khyol dang nub rgyud gsar spel byed pa'i 'gros dang bstun nas bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i las don nyid sgo kun nas nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong spel gnang ste nyams dga'i yul khams shig tu bskyal yod/ 'on kyang phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen du ma'i dbang gis rang 1

re'igaso rig thad kyi gzhung man ngag gi gdams pa gang mang nyams nyes su gyur dang 'gyur mus yin pa'ang nga tshos mig mthong lag zin du 'khums shing /bod kyi gso rig 'di nyid gna' bo'i rig gnas shig yin pa'i ngos nas zhu na/ri rgyal lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i gzhung man ngag gi gsung rab de rnams sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas sngog 'don myur skyob dang 'tshol sdud legs sgrig bcas byed rgyu ni thog mar bsgrub dgos pa'i rmang gzhi'i las ka gal chen zhig ste 'o skol tshe rig 'dzin pa rnams kyi phrag la rang bzhin gyis babs pa'i dus rabs kyi 'gan 'khri zhig lags/ de'i phyir nga tshos lo rgyus kyi las 'gan dang dus rabs kyi blang bya ltar mdo dbus mtho sgang zhes pa'i thun min khor yug khrod du 'phel rgyas byung ba'i gna' bo'i gso dpyad rig pa 'di'i srog dbugs rgyun bsrings byed cing / bod kyi gso dpyad rig par sbyang brtson dang zhib 'jug byed par spro ba brtas pa'i rnam dpyod can mang por rgyu cha mkho sprod kyi sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa/ rang lugs kyi gzhung rkang 'dzin pa la sngar bas sman thogs thub pa/ nyam thag nad pa'i lus srog la gzir ba'i nad rigs rtsa med du 'joms par nus pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rgyab rten dang man ngag zab mo'i gdams pa chig thub kyi skor mang du btsal nas nad kyi sdug bsngala'is skyob par rngo thogs pa bcas mdor na gangs can gso ba rig pa 'di nyid ming don mtshungs pa'i sgo nas rgyud 'dzin legs po zhig byed pa'i ched du/ nged cag mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang gis 'brel yod ched mkhas mi sna rtsa 'dzugs dang gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe dag sgrig gi mi sna ched bskos byas te/ lo rgyus yig cha dang / gzhung lugs bstan bcos/ man ngag lag len/ sman sbyor myong byang / sngo sman 'khrungs dpe/gnam rig skar rtsis sogs kyi dpe rgyun dkon po'i rigs gtso bor bzung thog 〈bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe tshogs 〉zhes pa 2

'di rtsom sgrig byas pa yin zhing / dpe skrun thad dpe deb re re bzhin mdzad pa'i lo rgyus kyi snga phyi dang nang don la ma bltos par lag len du 'khyol gang thub byas te dpe rnying lag tu son no cog dag sgrig dang dpe skrun 'grems spel bya rgyu yin/de la bod kyi gso rig 'dzin skyong spel gsum la thugs khur tshad med gnangs bzhin pa'i kan lho 'bum khos mkho sprod bgyis pa'i snum dpar gyi ma yig zhig gzhir byas nas bsgrigs pa'i 〈rgyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa dang yongs gtad rgyud kyi 'grel chen 〉zhes bya ba 'di ni 〈bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe tshogs 〉nang gses kyi deb don bzhi pa yin la/ 'di'i 〈bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa legs pa bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so 〉zhes pa'i nang du rus pa'i gnas lugs dang / lhu tshigs/ gnyan gnad sogs kyi grangs bgrang tshul dang / go dka' ba'i rgyud don/ rgyud bzhi'i rtsa tshig bar gyi 'brel ba/ rgyud 'grel bar gyi 'gal ba sogs la dgag bzhag gi lam nas rang lugs 'thad ldan du sgrub te gsal bar bstan yod/〈dpal ldan yongs su gtad pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel chen 〉zhes pa'i nang thog mar sman gyi dgos pa dang / de nas gso bya'i lus nad dang 'joms byed gnyen po bar gyi 'brel ba/ gzhan gnyen po kun gyi mchog dmigs su bkar te/ dus tha'i gnyan rims kyi bsrung thabs dngos/ mthar drang srong yid las skyes la sogs pas ston pa la bstod bsngags mdzad tshul dang / sgos su drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis rgyud la bstod pa byas nas rgyud 'di ma 'ongs pa na gang zag gi rigs gang la gtad rung ba dang gang la gtad mi rung ba'i skor sogs bstan yod/de yang dpe tshogs 'di nyid dag sgrig dang rtsom sgrig byed pa'i rtsa 'dzin 3

'di lta yin te/ 1 yi ge nor ba dang dogs gzhi can rnams la ming tshig gang de'i rjesasu rtagasatu3'di'i nang dag bcos byas yod/ 2 gzhung tshig chad par 'dod pa rnams rtags ()'di'i nang du kha skong byas yod/ 2 rtsom pa po'i mchan rnams gzhung dngos kyi yig gzugs las chung tsam byas nas bkod yod/ 4 ma yig mi gsal ba'am gzhung tshig chad pa rnams la kha skong byed ma nus pa rtags 'dis mtshon par byas yod la gug rtags 〈〉'di'i nang du ma yig gi shog grangs sam thig phreng ci tsam zhig chad yod pa gsal bshad byas yod/ 5 rgya tsha dang rgyam tsha sogs tshwa sna'i rigs rnams dag yig mkhas pa'i kha rgyan ltar te/ sog tsha dang rgya tsha zhes tshig grogs dang bsdeb na wa btags mi 'dogs shing / sog po'i tshwa dang rgya mtsho'i tshwa zhes pa'am tshwa ming rkyang pa'i skabs su wa btags 'dogs zhes pa ltar sbyar yod/lan tshwa zhes pa ni bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i dpe gzhung mang che bar bstun nas dmigs bsal du wa zur sbyar nas bkod yod/'dir nga tsho dag sgrig mi sna'i shes bya'i chu tshad dman zhing dpe rnying dag sgrig gi nyams myong zhan pa'i dbang gis ma rtogs 'gal 'khrul gyi cha gang mang yodasrid pa la rgya che klog pa po rnams kyis dgongs 'char lhugs par gnang bar bka' drin che zhu'o//mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang mas/dz+nyobodakli gso ba3ga pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe chogs〉rtsom sgrig chogs pa /spyi lo 2rkya07lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes /nyin/

dkar chag༄7ོ//bdud rtsi snyang po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa legs pa bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so//sa bcad dang po/ lus kyi gnas lugs bstan pa/ 4dang po/ ldang tshad lus zungs kyi gnas lugs bstan pa/ 4gnyis pa/ 'brel ba rtsa'i gnas lugs bstan pa/ 61 chags pa'i rtsa 62 srid pa'i rtsa/ 72 'brel pa'i rtsa 94 tshe yi rtsa 14gsum pa/ gnyan pa gnad kyi gnas lugs bstan pa/ 141 sha gnad bstan pa/ 142 tshil gnad bstan pa/ 152 rus pa'i gnad bstan pa/ 154 rgyus gnad bstan pa/ 165 don snod gnad bstan pa/ 166 rtsa gnad bstan pa/ 16sa bcad gnyis pa/ lus kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa/ 211

sa bcad gsum pa/ nad dang gnyen po gso thabs bstan pa/ 24dang po/ nad kyi dbye ba/ 241 nyes gsum gso ba'i skabs/ 262 khong nad gso ba'i skabs/ 322 tshad pa gso ba'i skabs/ 344 lus stod gso ba'i skabs/ 415 don snod gso ba'i skabs/ 426 gsang nad gso ba'i skabs/ 457 thor bu'i nad gso ba'i skabs/ 45ṭ+wāṃ lhan skyes rma gso'i skabs/ 499 byis pa gso ba'i skabs/ 501rkya mo nad gso ba'i skabs/ 5211 gdon nad gso ba'i skabs/ 5312 mtshon rma gso ba'i skabs/ 5412 dug nad gso ba'i skabs/ 5514 rgas pa gso ba'i skabs/ 5615 ro tsa gso ba'i skabs/ 56gnyis pa/ nad kyi gnyen po/ 59gsum pa/ nad kyi gso thabs/ 60sa bcad bzhi pa/ 'phel 'grib nad kyi dbye ba/ 69dang po/ nyes pa'i dbye ba/ 69gnyis pa/ gtso bo'i dbye ba/ 71gsum pa/ gnas kyi dbye ba/ 74bzhi pa/ rigs kyi dbye ba/ 762

sa bcad lnga pa/ span gyi ro smyor dang des nad kyi 'phel zad 'joms tshul/ 82sa bcad drug pa/ span gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 89dang po/ ro nus zhu rjes kyi rnam bzhag bstan pa/ 891 ro bstan pa/ 892 nus pa bstan pa/ 942 zhu rjes bstan pa/ 117gnyis pa/ sman so so'i ngos 'dzin bstan pa/ 1251 rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa'i brag zhun rigs lnga sogs bstan pa/ 1252 bshad rgyud las gsungs pa'i sman rdzas rnams bstan pa/ 129༄7//dpal ldan yongs su gtad pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel chen bzhugs so//rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ 189le'u dang po/ rgyad kyi mjug don bsdu ba bstan pa/ 193dang po/ mjug don bsdus na gang du 'du tshad zhu ba/ 193gnyis pa/ sman dang zas spyod kun gyi mchog rnams zhu ba/ 216gsum pa/ lnga brgya'i dus na nad dar shas che bas bdag gzhan bsrung ba'i thabs zhu ba/ 224bzhi pa/ rgyud 'dir ma 'dus pa'i gso dpyad gzhan yod med zhu ba/ 2353

le'u gnyis pa/ rgyudat+pa yongs gtad bstan pa/ — 238dang po/ gso rig sman gyi dgos pa zhu ba/ 238gnyis pa/ mi na bar gnas pa dang na ba gso ba'i thabs kyi 'brel ba zhu ba/ 243gsum pa/ drang srong yid las skyes la sogs pas ston par bstod pa zhu ba/ 245bzhi pa/ drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis rgyud la ched du bsngags pa zhu ba/ 247lnga pa/ rgyud 'di dus kyi tha mar gang la gtad dgos zhu ba/ 249sman sbyor ka phreng ltar bsgrigs pa'i bya ra/ 2544
snying po yan lab/ da bzhi'i rtsa bar+ṇa sa pa'i dbu phyob
ci

3༄7//bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo//gang sku blta bas mi ngoms mtshan dpe'i 'od ris g.yo// gang gsung yan lag drug cu'i sgra brnyan rgyud mangs mkhan// gang thugs shes bya'i tshogs kun gsal ba'i me long nyid// gang gis dug gsum nad sel sman pa de la 'dud//g.yu thog mgon pos mdzad pa yi// dpal ldan rgyud rgyal bzhir grags pa//kha ba can ljongs sman pa yi// blo gros gsal byed gcig pur 'khums// 'di la sngon byon mkhas pa yis// 'grel mdzad shin tu mang mod kyang // rjes 'jug dpyad pa 'khrul ba las// yi ge nyams pa 'ga' zhig mthong // de slad dka' ba'i gnas rnams la// rgyud kyi gong 'og kun brtags te// dgongs don 'khrul med lung rigs dang // mthun par 'dir ni brjod par spro//de la 'ga' zhig rgyud bzhi bkar 'bad pa chen pos sgrub mod/ 'di dag la dpyad na rnams (rnamakapar nyams par 'gyur bas/ bstan bcos su 'dod pa legs mod/ de lta na'ang rgya gar nas 'gyur ba'i slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i yan lag brgyad pa sogs las sman ming go bar dka' ba snang bas/ bod kha ba can rnams la rgyud bzhi nyid phan che zhing / 'on kyang rjes 'jug rnams kyis dpyad pas ma dag par rgyud bzhi 'grel ba dang bcas pa la yi ge ma dag pa 'ga' zhig mthong ste/ so sor grangs (bgrangakyeb dang / spyi sdoms grangs (bgrang1ba mi 'grigs pa dang / bshad rgyud kyi gnyan gnas (gnad1sogs grangs pa (bgrang ba3man ngag rgyud dang mi mthun pa snang bas so// des na 'dir rgyud bzhi nyid dbang tudapung1du btsugs/ mi gsal ba rnams 'grel bas gung sgrigs dka' ba'i gnas 'ga' zhig brjod par bya'o//

4 ༄༅khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/sa bcad dang po/ lus kyi gnas lugs bstan pa/de la rtsa ba'i rgyud ni mdor bstan yin pas/ gzhan gyi dka' ba'i gnas bkrol bas bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur la/ bshad pa'i rgyud las gzhung ma dag pa rnams gzhung bcos pas grub cing / lus kyi gnas lugs bstan pa'i skabs su/ ldang tshad lus zungs kyi gnas lugs bstan pa dang /'brel ba rtsa yi gnas lugs bstan pa dang / gnyan pa gnad kyi gnas lugs bstan pa dang / rgyu lam bu ga'i gnas lugs bstan pa dang sa bcad bzhis 'chad pa'i/dang po/ ldang tshad lus zungs kyi gnas lugs bstan pa/ldang tshad lus zungs gnas lugs bstan pa'i skabs su/ rus pa'i ldang tshad rus rigs nyi shu gsum/ zhes pa ni/ mgo la lnga/ byang khog la brgyad/ yan lag la bcu las/dang po mgo'i lnga la/ thod pa/ khrung khrung / so/ ltag pa/ ma 'gal (mgal3dang lnga'o//gnyis pa byang khog gi brgyad la/ sgal tshigs/ brang rus/ rtsib ma/lha ru rtse/ sgrog rus/ dpyi dbus(rus3/ sog pa/ gzhug thang (chung3dang brgyad/gsum pa yan lag gi bcu la/ tshigs dang / rus phran gnyis/ dang po tshigs la/ dpyi/ dpung ba/ pus mo/ gru mo/ 'khrig (mkhrigakyem/ long tshigs dang drug gnyis pa rus phran la/ lha nga / long ba'i dbus rus/ sre

72 ༄khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/zad pa ste zad pa dgu/ dril bas ldan pa bco brgyad/gnyis pa 'dus pa la/ rlung mkhris bad kan mtshungs par 'phel ba gcig rlung 'phel mkhris pa rab tu 'phel bad kan mchog tu 'phel ba dang /rlung 'phel bad kan rab tu 'phel mkhris pa mchog tu 'phel ba gnyis/mkhris pa 'phel rlung rab tu 'phel bad kan mchog tu 'phel ba dang / mkhris pa 'phel bad kan rab tu 'phel rlung mchog tu 'phel ba gnyis/ bad kan 'phel mkhris pa rab tu 'phel rlung mchog tu 'phel ba dang / bad kan 'phel rlung rab tu 'phel mkhris pa mchog tu 'phel ba gnyis te rab 'bring gsum sbyar drug rlung 'phel bad mkhris lhag par 'phel/ bad mkhris gnyis 'phel rlung lhag par 'phel/ mkhris pa 'phel/ bad rlung gnyis lhag par 'phel/ bad rlung gnyis 'phel/ mkhris pa lhag par 'phel/ bad kan 'phel/ mkhris rlung gnyis lhag par 'phel/ mkhris rlung gnyis 'phel/bad kan lhag par 'phel ba ste gnyis gcig lhag pa drug dril bas 'dus pa'i 'phel ba bcu gsum/rlung mkhris bad kan gsum mtshungs par zad pa gcig rlung zad mkhris pa rab tu zad bad kan mchog tu zad/ rlung zad bad kan rab tu zad mkhris pa mchog tu zad/ mkhris pa zad rlung rab tu zad/ bad kan mchog tu zad/ mkhris pa zad bad kan rab tu zad rlung mchog tu zad/bad kan zad mkhris pa rab tu zad rlung mchog tu zad/ bad kan zad rlung rab tu zad mkhris pa mchog tu zad/ rlung zad bad mkhris gnyis lhag par zad/ bad mkhris gnyis zad rlung lhag par zad/ mkhris pa zad bad rlung gnyis lhag par zad/ bad rlung gnyis zad mkhris pa lhag par zad/ bad kan zad mkhris rlung gnyis lhag par zad/ mkhris rlung gnyis zad bad kan lhag par zad pa ste 'dus pa'i zad pa bcu gsum dril bas 'dus pa'i 'phel

༄7/sa bcad bzhi pa/ 'phel 'grib nad kyi dbye ba/ 73zad nyi shu rtsa drug go/gsum pa zhar la 'phel zad 'dres pa la/ rlung mnyam mkhris pa 'phel bad kan zad pa dang / rlung mnyam bad kan 'phel/ mkhris pa zad pa gnyis/ mkhris pa mnyam bad kan 'phel rlung zad pa dang / mkhris pa mnyam rlung 'phel bad kan zad pa gnyis/ bad kan mnyam mkhris pa 'phel rlung zad pa dang / bad kan mnyam rlung 'phel mkhris pa zad pa gnyis te mnyam 'phel zad sbyar drug rlung zad bad mkhris gnyis 'phel/ mkhris pa zad bad rlung gnyis 'phel/ bad kan zad mkhris rlung gnyis 'phel ba ste gcig zad gnyis 'phel gsum/ bad mkhris zad rlung 'phel/ bad rlung gnyis zad mkhris pa 'phel/ mkhris rlung gnyis zad bad kan 'phel ba ste go zlog (ldog3gnyis zad gcig 'phel gsum dang drug dril bas 'phel zad 'dres pa bcu gnyis/ sdoms pas 'phel zad dbye ba bdun cu rtsa bzhi/bzhi pa bla gnyan nad la/ zhugs pa/ log pa/ 'dom pa dang gsum/dang po zhugs pa la/ rlung gi gnas su mkhris pa zhugs pa/ bad kan zhugs pa/ bad mkhris gnyis ka zhugs pa dang gsum/ mkhris pa'i gnas su rlung zhugs pa/ bad kan zhugs pa/ bad rlung gnyis ka zhugs pa dang gsum/bad kan gyi gnas su rlung zhugs pa/ mkhris pa zhugs pa/ mkhris rlung gnyis ka zhugs pa dang gsum ste dril bas zhugs pa dgu/ gnyis pa log pa la/rlung ma zhi bar mkhris par log pa/ bad kan du log pa/ bad mkhris gnyis gar log pa dang gsum/ mkhris pa ma zhi bar bad kan du log pa/ rlung du log pa/ bad rlung gnyis kar log pa dang gsum/ bad kan ma zhi bar rlung du log pa/ mkhris par log pa/ mkhris rlung gnyis kar log pa dang gsum ste dril bas log pa dgu/ gsum pa 'dom pa nad sna gnyis su 'thab pa la/rlung gis mkhris yul phrogs nas bad kan dang 'thab pa/ bad kan gyi yul

74 ༄༅khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/phrogs nas mkhris par 'thab pa/ rang yul bzung nas gnyis kar 'thab pa dang gsum/ mkhris pas rlung gi yul bzung nas bad kan dang 'thab pa/bad kan gyis rlung gi yul phrogs nas mkhris pa dang 'thab pa/ mkhris pa'i yul bzung nas rlung dang 'thab pa/ rang yul bzung nas gnyis kar 'thab pa dang gsum ste dril bas 'dom pa dgu/ sdoms pas bla gnyan nyi shu rtsa bdun/ spyir sdoms pas gtso bos dbye ba brgya dang gcigagasum pa/ gnas kyi dbye ba/gsum pa gnas kyi dbye ba la/ sems la gnas pa dang / lus la gnas pa gnyis/ dang po sems la gnas pa la/ smyo byed dang / rjed byed gnyis/ gnyis pa lus la gnas pa la/ stod la gnas pa/ smad la gnas pa/phyi la gnas pa/ phyi nang gnas pa dang bzhi/ dang po stod la gnas pa/ mgo la gnas pa dang / don snod la gnas pa gnyis/ dang po mgo la gnas pa la/mgo bo'i nad/ mig nad/ rna ba'i nad/ sna'i nad/ so'i nad/ lce'i nad/rkan gyi nad/ gre ba'i nad/ lba ba'i nad/ nam tshangs (tshong3gi nad dang bcu gcig dang po mgo bo'i nad gcig gnyis pa mig nad gcigagasum pa rna ba'i nad gcig bzhi pa sna'i nad gcig lnga pa mchu'i nad gcig drug pa so'i nad gcig bdun pa lce'i nad gcig brgyad pa rkan gyi nad gcig dgu ba gre ba'i nad la/ na ba/ gag pa/ mgul 'gags/skad 'gags dang bzhi/ bcu pa lnga ba'i nad gcig bcu gcig pa nam tshangs tutshong3nad la/ skom dad/ skyigs bu/ dbugs mi bde ba/ yi ga 'chus pa/ cham pa dang lnga ste dril bas mgo bo'i nad la bco brgyad/gnyis pa don snod la gnas pa la/ so sor gnas pa dang / spyir

༄༅/sa bcad bzhi pa/ 'phel 'grib nad kyi dbye ba/ 75gnas pa gnyis/ dang po so sor gnas pa la/ snying la gnas pa/ glo bar gnas pa/ mchin par gnas pa/ mtsher par gnas pa/ mkhal mar gnas pa/ pho bar gnas pa/ mkhris par gnas pa/ rgyu long la gnas pa/ ldang par gnas pa/ mngal na gnas pa/ sam (bsam3se'ur gnas pa dang bcu gcig gnyis pa spyir gnas pa la/ don snod spyir gnas pa dang / snod spyiraganas pa gnyis/ dang po don snod spyir gnas pa la/ ma zhu ba/ glang thabs/ skran/ sur+ya/ tshad 'khru/ rgyu gzer dang drug gnyis pa snod spyir gnas pa la 'khru ba dang skyugs pa gnyis te dril bas don snod la gnas pa bcu dgu/gnyis pa smad la gnas pa la/ gzhang 'brum/ mtshan bar rdol ba/stug (rtug3'gags/ gcin 'gags/ gcin snyi dang lnga/gsumapa phyir gnas pa la/ lpags tupags3pa la gnas pa/ rtsa la gnas pa/ sha la gnas pa/ rus la gnas pa/ kun la gnas pa dang lnga/dang po lpags tupags1pa la gnas pa la/ sha bkra/ bal 'dags(bas ldags3/ g.yan pa/ glang shu/ za rkong / shu ba/ reg pa'i dug mdzer pa/ngo khebasatukhabasaka/ nad gzhan pags la gram pa dang bcu/ gnyis pa rtsa la gnas pa la/ rtsa dkar nad/ rtsa nag nad/ nad gzhan rtsa la gram pa dang gsum/ gsum pa sha gnas la/ lnga ba/ men bu/ nad gzhan sha la rgyas pa dang gsum/ bzhi pa rus gnas la/ dreg rkang bam/ nad gzhan rus la zhen pa dang gsum/ lnga ba kun la gnas pa la grum bu'i nad gcig te dril bas phyir gnas nyi shu/bzhi pa phyi nang gnas pa la/ mkhris pa/ srug po/ dmu chu/ 'or/ skya rbab/ gcong chen zad byed/ tsha ba ma smin pa/ rgyas pa/ stongs pa/ gab pa/rnying pa/ rnyogs pa/ 'grams/ 'khrugs/ rims kyi tsha ba bal nad/

76 ༄༅khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/'brum bu/ lhog pa/ sbyar dug rdzi dug zer dug rlangs dug sha dugami 'phrod pa'i dug btsan dug khyi dug srin bu'i dug sgrul duga'abyung po/ gza'/ mdze/ 'bras/ me dbal/ smin (men3/ mgo rma/byangakhog rma/ yan lag rma/ ske'i rma dang sum cu so bdun te/ sdoms pas gnas kyi dbye ba brgya dang gcig bzhi pa/ rigs kyi dbye ba/ bzhi ba rigs kyi dbye ba la/ khong nad/ rma nad/ tshad nad/ thor bu'i nad dang bzhi/ dngabyupo khodze+end la/ rgyu ma zhu ba dang / 'bras bu gcong nad gnyis/ dang po rgyu ma zhu ba la/ ngo bo/ rigs/ grogs/ dus kyi dbye ba dang bzhi/ gnyis pa 'bras bu gcong nad la/ gsar pa dang / rnying ba gnyis/ dang po gsar ba la/ bad kan skya bo/ smug po/ mkhris nad/ dug gcong dang bzhi/ dang po bad kan skya bo la/ lhon/ lcags dreg me nyams/mgul 'gags/ grum bu dkar po/ 'ju skems dang drug gnyis pa srug po la/ byer/ rgyas/ rdol/ ral/ 'gyings/ 'dril/ gab/ 'thab/ 'or lhung / grang ba lding tshad tulhing chad1dang bcu/ gsum pa mkhris pa la/ thang lhags/ gnas 'gyur/ kha lud/ rtsa rgyug dang bzhi/ bzhi pa dug gcong la/tsha sbyor dang / grang sbyor gnyis te dril bas gsar ba nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ gnyis pa rnying ba la/ skran/ dmu chu/ 'or/ skya rbab/ gcong chen zad byed dang lnga/dang po skran la/ khrag skran/ mkhris skran/ lhon skran/ rdo skran/ rlung skran/srin skran/ rtsa skran/ chu skran dang brgyad/ gnyis pa dmu chu la/ byer chu/zags chu/ 'khyil chu dang gsum/ gsum pa 'or la/ tsha 'or dang grang 'or gnyis/ bzhi pa skya rbab la/ glo ba skya rbab/ snying gi skya rbab/ mchin pa skya

sku'i+o/sa bcad bzhi pa/ 'phel 'grib nad kyi dbye ba/ 77rbab/ mtsher ba skya rbab/ chu ser skya rbab dang lnga/ lnga pa gcong chen zad byed la/ rlung gyur/ mkhris gyur/ bad kan las gyur pa/ gcong chen nad kyi bla gnyan dang bzhi ste dril bas rnying pa la nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ sdoms pas khong nad bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/gnyis pa rma nad la/ lhan skyes kyi rma dang / glo bur ba'i rma gnyis/dang po lhan skyes rma la/ 'bras/ rmen bu/ sur+ya/ rkang bam/ me dbal/gzhang 'brum/ rlig lug mtshan bar rdol ba dang brgyad/ gnyis pa glo bur gyi rma la/ gnas kyi dbye ba dang / rigs kyi dbye ba gnyis/ dang po gnas kyi dbye ba la/ mgo byang khog yan lag gi rma dang gsum/ gnyis pa rigs kyi dbye ba la/ bshus bcad/ rnam par bcad/ 'phyang lhung phug gshags/drug tugrums1pa dang brgyad de dril bas rma la bcu dgu/gsum pa tshad nad la/ ma smin rgyas stong gab rnying rnyogs 'grams 'khrugs rims tshad dang dgu/ dang po ma smin pa la gcig gnyis pa rgyas pa la gcig gsum pa stongs pa la gcig bzhi pa gab pa la gcig lnga ba rnying pa la gcig drug pa rnyogs pa la gcig bdun pa 'grams pa la phyi 'grams dang / nang 'grams gnyis/ brgyad pa 'khrugs la/ rgyas 'khrugs/stongs 'khrugs/ 'jam 'khrugs dang gsum/ dgu pa rims la/ bal nad/rgyu gzer/ 'brum bu/ gag lhog cham pa dang lnga ste dril bas tshad nad bcu drugabazhi pa thor ba'i nad la/ skad 'gags/ skyigs bu/ yi ga 'chus pa/skom dad/ dbugs mi bde ba/ glang thabs/ srin/ 'khru nad/ skyugs nad/ dri ma 'gags pa/ gcin 'gags pa/ gcin snyi ba/ tshad 'khru/dreg nad/ grum bu/ chu ser/ rtsa dkar nad/ lpags (pags3nad dang bco brgyad/ sdoms pas rigs kyi dbye ba brgya dang gcig yin no//

78 sa༅khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/de la zad skabs su dpyad par bya ste/ grangs la dpyad pa dang/ nad la dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ zla zer las/ de yang rlung 'phel ba dang mkhris pa 'phel ba dang / bad kan 'phel ba ste/ de ltar nad kyi dbye ba rnam pa gsum du shes par bya ba dang / zhes dang / de yang nad gzhi 'di gsum po so sor zad pa las gsum rdu 'gyur te rlung zad pa dang / mkhris pa zad pa dang / bad kan zad pa ste/ de ltar nad kyi dbye ba gsum du shes par bya'o//zhes dang / de ltar rlung la sogs pa nad gzhi'i dbye ba ni/ spyir drug cu rtsa gnyis su bstan cing bshad pa'am/ drug cu rtsa gsum du bston (ston3to/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bde bar gnas rgyu zhes bya ba ste/ bde ba'i rgyur gyur ba nyid kyi phyir ro// zhes gsungs pas/ yan lag brgyad pa rtsa 'grel du/'phel zad dngos su drug cu rtsa gnyis dang / bde bar gnas pa dang drug cu rtsa gsum gsungs pa dang / 'dir bdun bcu rtsa bzhir gsungs pa grangs ma mthun zhing / de yang / rkyang ba'i nyes gsum la 'phel ba re/ zad pa re grangs pas drug tu yan lag brgyad pa rtsa 'grel du byung la/ 'dir de'i steng du/ rab 'phel/ mchog 'phel re/ rab zad/ mchog zad re grangs (bgrangapyapas bco brgyad byung bas bcu gnyis lhag pa'i skyon du 'gyur ram snyam na/ skyon med de/ yan lag brgyadatshopa rtsa 'grel du/ ro sdebs sbyor pa lnga bcu rtsa bdun dang / rkyang pa drug sbyar pas drug cu rtsa gsum dang nad dang gnyen po sprad pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ rkyang pa'i 'phel zad bcu gnyis 'dus pa'i rab 'phel mchog 'phel dang rab zad mchog zad kyi khong du bsdus nas bstan la/ 'dir de dag la rkyang pa dang 'dus pa'i cha so so ba yod pa'i dbang du byas nas bstan pa'i phyir dang / zla zer du'ang dug bcu gsum las lhag par sbyang rung bar bstan pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ nad kyi dbye ba 'di dag dang dngas ma la sogs pa 'dres shing 'dus pa dang / de

༄7/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 115kan gyi 'jam pa 'brad cing / 'byar bag gcod par byed do// 'jam pa tsub pas 'brad par byed// 'byar bag tsub pas dum bur gcod// de phyir 'jam 'byar so so yang // gnyen po tsub pa gcig gis 'joms// zhesa.oṃ//g.yo bas bad kan gyi brtan pa sel te/ dus kyi rlung gis ri rab kyang 'jig pa bzhin/ 'dir rgyu'i nus pa'i dus su/ rno brtul (rtul3rno bas 'joms pa dang / lci yang lci bas 'joms pa dang / tsha bsil tsha bas 'joms pa sogs bshad la/ 'dir de dag go bzlog (ldog1par 'gal snyam na mi 'gal te/ gong du rgyu'i skabs su rdzas kyi nus pa stobs che chung snyoms pa la/ rang gi ngo bo'i nus pa rno ba sogs stobs che ba'i dbang du byas la/ 'dir gnyen po rnams rdzas kyi nus stobs che bas/ rang gi ngo bo'i nus pa zil gyis mnan pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ngo bo'i —nus pa ni/ ngo bo rdzas re'i nus pa bstan pa ni// zhes sogs nus pa rkyang sel nas bshad pa yin la/ 'di dag la'ang ro la bsten padang / ro med kyang rdzas ngo bo'i nus pa dang / ga bur gla rtsi sogs dri kho nas nus pa 'byin pa dang / khru —gang 'og sa dang thod rus sogs rten 'brel gyi nus pa sogs yod par bshad do// gzhan las bshad tshul ni/ yan lag brgyad pa las/ sman mthu la las bshad pa ni// lci snum bsil dang 'jam pa dang // yang tsub tsha dang rno ba ste//de ltar rnam pa brgyad du 'dod// sman mthu tsa ra kas bshad pa// gang gi bya ba gang byed pa// mthu min ci yang mi byed kyi// de dag thams cad mthu yis byed// de nas lci la stsogs pa nyid// nus pa'i khyad par ldan pa dang // yon tan ma lus snying bor ni// gyur bas mthu zhes bshad pa dag/ don dang mthun par btags pa yin// gces pa mang du yod na yang // tha snyad gtso bo nyid kyis yin// de bas go ni bzlog (ldog3pa'i phyir// de ni ro la stsogs pa

116 ༄7ོkhyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/la// srid du zin kyang ma bshad de// de bas lci ba la sogs yin// gzhan dag tsha dang bsil nyid gnyis// stobs yin zhes kyang ston par byed// sman ni tshogs pa bdag nyid can// nyi ma zla ba'i stobs can yin// 'gro 'di gsal dang mi gsal las// nam yang 'da' bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes dang /zla zer las/ da ni sman gyi nus pa bshad pa rtsom par byed de/ de ni sman mthu la las bshad pa ni// lcisnrum bsil dang 'jam pa dang // yang tsub tsha dang rno ba steka de ltar rnam pa brgyad du 'dom/ zhes bya ba la sman gyi mthu ni thams cad du thogs pa dang / sdugs (rdugasakyepa med pyol 'gro ba yin pa ni sman gang la lon tan gyi rigs gang cung zad yod de thams cad la mthu 'am nus pa zhesu bya'o// de la slob dpon gzhan dag gis bshad pa ni/ sman gyi mthu lci ba la stsogs pa'i yon tan gyi dbye bas rnam pa brgyad du 'chad de/ de ltar rnam pa 'di ni grangs kyi rnam pa brgyad yin par slob dpon dag 'dod cing 'chad kyi/ rnam pa gzhan gyis ni rnam grangs 'di ngesatro can du 'dod sde—— do// sman mthu tsa ra kas bshad pa/ gang gis bya ba gang byed pa// mthu min cir yang mi byed kyi// de dag thams cad mthu yis byed// ces bya ba la/drang srong tsa ra kas sman gyi mthu 'am/ nus ya bshad cing bstan pa ni/dngos po gang zhig byed pa gang la zhugs shing bya ba gang zhig rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i dngos bo'i rang bzhin te de'i mthu yin no/ zhes gsungs pas/ sman gyi mthu ni nad la thogs pa med pa dang / sdugs (rdugs1pa med pa'i tshulnga gyis gzhom pa la bya zhing / de yang—'ga' zhig gis/ lce sogs brgyad po rnam grangs par 'dod pa dang / 'ga' zhig brgyad ka tshang ba la 'dod pa dang /'ga' zhig sman gyi nus pa rdzogs dus mthun par 'dod pa'i na yams mdzad par gnang zhing / mtshan nyid nyi shu yon tan nyi shus 'joms par yang bshad do// dper na rlung gi phra ba'i gnyen por nus pa sbom pa gtong ba sogs cung

༄7/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 117zad mi mthun par snang ngo // 2 zhu rjes bstan pa/gsum pa zhu rjes bstan pa ni/ bshad rgyud las/ zhu rjes pho ba'i me dang 'phrad pa las// bad mkhris rlung gis rim pas zhu rjes la(par zhu ba las3/ / mngar dang lan tsha'i (tshwa'i3zhu rjes mngar bar zhu// skyur ba ro mtshungs kha tsha ska (bska3gsum kha// nyes pa gsum gyi gnyis gnyis re res sel// zhes pas/ de yang ji ltar zhu tshul ni/ dang po ro drug zas skom gang zos pa// bad kan myag byed dag gis myags par byed// ro mngar lbu ba can gyur bad kan bskyed// bar du mkhris pa 'ju byed kyis bzhu (bzhus3pas//rnam par tsha bas ro skyur mkhris pa skyed// mtha' mar me mnyam rlung gis dngas snyigs 'byed// kha bar gyur te de yis rlung bskyed 'gyur// zhes dang /bad mkhris rlung gi rim pas shes pa— mthun pas/ spyir bstan zas skom gang zos kyang thog mar bad kan myags byed kyis myags pas ro mngar ba dang /bar du mkhris pa 'ju byed kyis bzhu bas ro skyur ba dang / mtha' mar ṣ+pemanyamarlung gis dwangs snyigs phye bas kha bar 'gyur bas rim pa gsum yod kyang / sman spyir bstan pa'am/ mngar ba dang lan tsha'i (tshwa'i1zhu rjes mngar ba dang / skyur ba'i zhu rjes skyur ba dang / kha tsha ska (bskakagasum gyi zhu rjes kha bar zhu bar bzhed do| 'o na de dag la rlung mkhris bad kan yod med kyi khyad par yod dam med// yod na skyur kha tsha ska (bskakabazhi la mkhris pa 'ju byed dang // rlung me mnyam gyi las mi 'jug par gyur la/ med na ro thams cad la yang zhu rjes kyi skabs gsum du 'gyur bas sman spyir bstan gyi zhu rjes dang 'gal lo zhe na/ skyon med de/ ro thams cad la bad kan myag byed dang /mkhris pa 'ju byed dang / me mnyam rlung gsum ka'i bya ba 'jug kyang / lan tsha (tshwa1dang mngar ba la bad kan myag byed kyi las gtso che ba dang / skyur ba

118 sku'i+okhyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/la mkhris pa 'ju byed kyi las gtso che ba dang / kha tsha ska (bska1gsum —la me mnyam rlung gi las gtso che ba'i khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ des na bad kan zos thog ldang ba dang / rlung zhu rjes ldang —ba dang / de gnyis kyi rigs pas mkhris pa zhu dus ldang ba'i khyad par yang 'thad pa yin no// bye brag tu zhu rjes de dag tu ma nges zla zer las/ da ni pho ba'i zhes bya la stsogs pa'i tshig tu bcas pas 'ju ba smras pa yin te/ pho ba'i me dang 'phrad pa las// gang zhig ro gzhan 'byung 'gyur ba'i// ro rnams kyi ni mthar zhu ba// de ni zhu ba zhes bshad do// zhes bya ba la pho ba'i me dang smanathaphrad cing 'dus pa las gang ro gzhan du gyur ba ste mngar ba la sogs pa'i ro gzhan dag tu 'byung bar gyur pa zas kyi las kyi mthar thug pa na mngar ba dang skyur ba dang / tsha ba'i ro rnams kyi zhu ba'i mtha' mar gang zhig zhusnazhing smin par 'gyur ba de ni zhu ba zhes bya'o// zhes drang srong dag gis bshad doke ci ltar mngar ba'i ro zos pa na mngar bar ro khyad par 'byung ba de'i bstan bcos shes patshodag gis zhu ba yin no// zhes bshad do// de nyid kyi phyir smras pa ni/ mngar dang lan tsha'i (tshwa'i1zhu rjes mngar// skyur ba'i zhu rjes skyur ba yine// kha dang tsha dang ska (bska3ba rnams// zhu rjes phal cher kha ba yin// zhes bya ba la/— mngar ba ni dri zhim pa'o// lan tsha tutshwa3ni tsha rnams te/ de gnyis ni zhu ba'i rjes mngar bar 'gyur ba'o// ro skyur ba zosatshopa'i zhu rjes kyang skyur bar bstan pa yin no//ro kha ba dang tsha ba dang ska (bska3ba rnams ni phal cher kha bar 'ju ba yin no//de la phal cher zhes smos pa ni kha gcig tu 'dir smos pa dang mi mthun pa yod de 'bru la gnas pa'i ro mngar ba ni zhu ba'i rjes skyur ba'i (bar3'gyur ba des na 'bru ni ro mngar yang zhu rjes skyur ba yin pas mkhris pa bskyed cing lci ba yin no// de bzhin du a ru ra dang bca' sga dang sga gsher dang / pi pi la stsogs pa yang sbyar bar bya'o// de yang bsdus pa las/ 'bru ni mngar yang

༄7/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 119skyur ba nyid// de bzhin se'u skyur yang mngar// til dmar (mar3kha bar gyur ba dang // pi pi ling yang ska (bskakabar 'gyur// zhes bshad pa yin no//des de ltar na 'bru ni mngar du zin kyang zhu ba'i rjes skyur bar 'gyur ba dang /til mar skyur du zin kyang kha bar 'ju ba dang / pi pi ling tsha yang zhu rjes ska (bska3bar 'gyur ba yin no// des na 'di ltar mi mthun pa dag sh+tsang yod pas phal cher zhes smos pa yin no// zhes gsungs pas/ spyir mngar ba'i zhu rjes mngar ba yin yang / 'bru mngar yang zhu rjes skyur ba ni/ mkhris pa 'ju byed kyi las gtso che ba dang / skyur ba'i zhu rjes skyur ba yin yang / til mar skyur yang zhu rjes kha ba ni/ rlung me mnyam gyi las gtso che ba dang / tsha ba'i zhu rjes kha ba yin yang / pi pi ling tsha yang zhu rjes ska jibaska1ba ni/ rlung me mnyam gyi las gnyis su 'gyur ba'i don dang / se'u skyur yang zhu rjes mngar ba ni/ bad kan myag byed kyi las gtso che bas don dang / a ru ra dang bca' sga dang sge'u gsher sogs rang rang gi ro'i zhu rjes spyi dang mi mthun pa so sor zhu ba rnams gong gi rigs pas dpyad dgos pa'i don no// 'bum nag tu/mngar kha ska skyobaska3gsum bad kan la mi gnod tsha bar zhu ba dang / tsha skyur ska (bska3gsum bad kan la mi phan na mngar ba (bar3zhu ba dang / mngar skyur lan tsha (tshwa1rlung la mi phan na kha bar zhu ba dang / kha ska (bska3tsha gsum rlung la mi gnod na lan tshar (tshwar3zhu ba dang / kha mngar ska (bska1bas mkhris pa la mi phan na tsha bar zhu ba dang / tsha skyur lan tshwas mkhris pa la mi gnod na ska (bska1bar zhu ba ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan phan gnod nus pa'i zhu rjes mngar skyur kha gsum du 'dus pa bkod snang bas/ zhu tshul 'di rnams kyis nyes gsum la phan gnod med par 'dra zhing / zla zer dang cung zad mi mthun par snang ngo //bzhi ba de dag gi nad sel tshul la dpyad pa ni/ 'o na ro nus zhu rjes gang gi nad sel zhes na/ bshad rgyud las/ ro sogs ma bcos gang yang

120 sku'i+okhyugabazhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/stobs can yin// ro mnyam nus pa so so bsten stobs dang // gyur pa sbyar ba'i dbang las 'byung bar 'gyur// mi mthun 'og mas gong ma zil gyis gnon// thams cad mthun na ro yi las byed la// ro bzhin mi gnod zhu rjes las byed de// ro las go bzlog tuldog3nus pas las byed pas// ro sdebs nus sdebs zhu rjes sdebs te sbyar// zhes gsungs pas/ ros las byed pa yang yod/ nus pas las byed pa yang yod/ zhu rjes kyi las byed pa yang yod la/ de yang ro nus pa zhu rjes gsum ka nad sel ba'i bya ba la mthun na ma bcos pa yin pas stobs che la/ ro mnyam pa la nus pa so sor bsten pa/ ka ra bu ram rnying pa mngar bar mtshungs kyang ka ra bsil/ bu ram dro ba lta bu dang / skyur ba sbyar ba'i dbang las grogs kyi ro mnyam pa yang nus pa so sor 'byung ba dang / ro nus zhu rjes gsum mi mthun na nus pas zhu rjes zil gyis gnon/ zhu rjes kyis ro zil gyis gnon te nus pa gtso che ba dang / ro nus zhu rjes gsum ga mthun na ros las byed de/ ro'i las las gzhan gnyis la nus pa khyad par du byar med pa'i phyir/ ro bzhin mi gnod zhu rjes kyi las byed de/se'u skyur la yang zhu rjes mngar bas bad kan bskyed pa lta bu'o// ro las go bzlog (ldog1nus pas las byed de/ nus pa gtso che ba'i phyir/ des na ro nus zhu rjes mthun pa'i ro sdebs dang / zhu rjes mthun pa'i zhu rjes sdebs pa dang / nus pa mthun pa'i nus sdebs byas te sbyar ro// 'dir zla zer las/ro nus zhu rjes gang las gang stobs dang ldan pas bya ba byed par bshad de/sman gyi ro sogs gang dang gang // stobs ldan nyid kyis gnas byed do// shin tu zil mnan de dang de// sgrub byed rgyu ni nyid du gnas// zhes bya ba la sman gyi rigs su gtogs pa'i ro dang / 'ju ba dang mthu rnams gang dang gang yin pa de dag gi nang nas stobs dang ldan pa nyid kyis sman la gnas par byed pa des ni sman gyi rigs de nyid du zil gyis mnan cing / stobs chung ba

༄༅/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 121gzhan dag pham par byas nas/ gnas sa de dang de ni bya ba gang sgrub par byed pa de dag ni rgyu nyid du gnas par 'gyur zhing sgrub bar bya ba nyid bsgrub par byed pa yin no// de yang ro yis ni 'di byas so// nus pas ni 'di byas so// stobs kyis ni 'di byas so zhes pa lta bu'o// zhes gsungs pas/ ros bya ba byed pa ni ro stobs dang ldan pa dang / zhu rjes kyis bya ba byed pa ni zhu rjes stobs dang ldan pa dang / nus pas bya ba byed pa ni nus pa stobs dang ldan pa'i don no// des na ro nus zhu rjes gsum ga las mthun na ro stobs dang ldan pa dang / ro bzhin mi gnod na zhu rjes stobs dang ldan pa dang / ro las go bzlog ltaldog3nus pa stobs dang ldan pa ste/ mngar ba spyir bstan du ro mngar/ zhu rjes mngar bar zhu/ nus pa lci snum bsil brtul (rtul3dang ldan pa ni/ thams cad mthun pas ros las byed pa ste/ ro dang zhu rjes mngar bas mkhris rlung sel bad kan bskyed/ nus pa bzhi gas bad kan bskyed/ lci snum gyis rlung sel/ lci bsil brtul skyortulakabs mkhris pa sel bas/ gsum ga mtshungs kyang / ro las gzhan gnyis la nus pa khyad par du byar med pa'o// tsha bas mkhris pa bskyed kyang pi pi ling gis mkhris pa mi bskyed pa ni/ zhu rjes ska skyibaska3bas las byas te rgyu me rlung las byung ba'i ro tsha ba/ sa'i lce brtan brtul (rtul1ba dang ldan pas ska (bska3bar zhu bas mkhris pa mi skyed/ tsha rno rtsub yang gis bad kan sel/ lci snum gyis rlung sel brten drags na/ yang tsub kyis rlung bskyed pa'o// des na ro dang nus pa las mkhris pa mi bskyed pas khyad par du byas pa'o// ro las go bzlog (ldog1pa skyur bas mkhris pa bskyed kyang skyu ru ras khrag mkhris sel ba lta bu ste/ rgyu sa me las skyu ru ra'i skabs 'dir chu'i shas dang ldan pas ro dang zhu rjes skyur yang nus pa'i skabs su bsil bas tsha ba'i nus pa bcom nas bsil brtul (rtul3gyis khrag mkhris sel bas ro dang zhu rjes las nus pa khyad par du gyur

122 ༄༅khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/ba'o// 'di dag gis mtshon nas ro spyi bye brag mi mthun pa rnams la rgyu'i khyad par du cung zad yod par shes par bya'o// 'bum nag tu lci snum gyi dro ba med na rlung sel mi nus pas/ grogs dro ba dang ldan na mkhris rlung sel bar bshad pa ni/ ro re res ldan pa'i nad sel ba'i dbang du mdzad la/ nus pa'i lci snum gyis rlung sel ba ni nad rkyang pa'i dbang du byed dgos pas grogs dang sdebs mi dgos pa snang ngo // gzhan yang nad sel tshul zla zer las/ de la sman ni bzang ngan dang // la la ro yis las byed pa// gzhan dag 'ju bar byed pa yod// yon tan gzhan dag nus pa dang // mthu yis las la byed pa yin// zhes bya ba la/ de la zhes bya ba ni/ nges par gzung ba ste/ sman dang ro dang nus pa dang / mthu stobs kyi nang nas sman ni bzang dang ngan zhes bya ba ste/ yod pa dang med pa'i las sman la la'i ro yis byed pa dang /gzhan dag ni 'ju bas las byed pa dang / las bzang ngan gzhan dag nus pas byed pa dang / las gzhan dang gzhan dag mthu yiso byed pa yin no//'di dag ni bsdus pa las rgya cher bshad de/ dper na sbrang rtsi ni ro mngar du zin yang 'ju ba'i rjes kha ba dang / ska (bska3ba dang bcas pas bad kan zhi bar byed cing nus pa bsil bar byed pas rlung skyed par byed do// rlan can gyi sa'i chu ni nus pa dro ba yin pas mkhris pa skyed par byed do// de bzhin du til mar ni zhu rjes kha ba nyid kyis bshang lci bskyed la/ rang skyur yang tsub cing dro ba yin pa dang / bil ba'i rkang ni tsub pas mkhris pa skyed pa dang /skyu ru ra ni nus pa bsil ba dang / zhu rjes mngar bas bad kan skyed pa dang /yang zhing tsub kyang rlung mi skyed pa dang / lan tsha tutshwa3lce myang tsha ni zhu rjes mngar bas mkhris pa sel cing yang bas bad kan nad la phan pa dang / pu shel rtse dang bca' sga ni snum pa dang dro ba dang / zhu rjes mngar bas rlung sel ba dang / pi pi ling yang de dang 'dra bas rlung sel ba dang / sgog skya dang

༄༅/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nusazhu rjes bstan pa/ 131mu tig dug sel klad pa gso// 'phra men gza' nad ma lus sel// byu ru 'dus pa'i nad la phan// ka shi la yis gdon kun bsrungs// phal pa'i dung bsregs 'dril kun 'jigs// gzi rnying mig nad sel bar byed// mchong dang me tog de dang 'dra// rdo dang srog chags las byung bcu// lce spyang ra (rwa3yis nor rnams bsrung // sbrul gyi nor bus dug la phan// ku sha bhan rdas rims nad sel// gser len dbyig dug bsdud cing sel// reg chod skran nad 'joms par byed// gla ba'i nor bus sbrul dug phan// nya sogs srog chags klad pa'i nang // rdo ba 'char 'bebs so sor phan// chu tshan ring bsrel gdon nad sel// nya phyis klad pa 'dzag pa gcod// 'ju byed shel rdo dug la phan/ de ltar nor bu'i cha gtog tugatogs3bcu// ro bcud rgyal po dngul chu ni// gnyen po grogs sbyar nad kun sel// tshe ring nor rnams kun 'grub byed// gser gyis rgas pa rnam par 'joms// dngul gyis so ni bzang bor 'gyur// lcags kyis chu dang mtshon rnams bzlog/ zangs kyis dmu rdzing skems par byed// 'khar ba ra gan mig nad sel// klu ni nag dang dkar ba gnyis// gdon bsrung spu rnams nag por byed// 'di rnams lcags brgyad gnyen pos bsad// yon tan kun ster shes par bya// zhes gsungs pas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel nor bu'i mchog dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar byed pa dang / de 'og byang sems/ de 'og rang rgyal/ de 'og nyan thos kyi ring bsrelayin la/ rnal 'byor ldan pa ni byang sems/ rang rgyal nyan thosagang yang rung ba dang 'dra bas/ de rnams gdon bsrung ba sogs kyi phan yon dang ldan pa'o//de nas nor bu rnams la/ shel rigs/ rdo rigs/ bcos ma gsum gsum las/ dang po la nor bu rin po che/ gnyis pa la mching bu/ gsum pa bcos bu zhes tha snyad 'dogs la/ bcos bu ni lugs su blug pa'o//

132 ༄༅khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/be+eḍūr+ya ni sngo skya shin tu dngas pas nam mkha' la khyer na mi mngon pa yin la de ni shel rigs so// mching bu ni rdo rigs cung zad sngo skya nam mkha' la khyer yang snang ba'o// be+eḍūr+ya yang zer/ bcos bu ni shel blugs de dang mthun pa'i kha dog bsgyur pa'o//in+d+ra nī la ni de bas cung zad sngo kha khengs tsam mo// in+d+ra snyil yang de dang don gcig par bzhed do// bsgyur na dbang bo sngon po zhes bya bar 'gyur ro//rdo rje ni pha lam ste dkar gro brgyad gzhogs kyi rnam pa rang grub9tu yod pa'o// badz+ra nyi ra zer ro//pad+ma rā ga ni dmar dngas te pad+ma dmar po'am chags pa'i pad+ma'o//margad ni ljang gu ste marga ta zhes so// byi la'i mig ni ser smug ste go mo da zhes so//chu shel ni shel shin tu dngas pa zla ba phrad na chu 'byung ba'o// tsan+d+ra kān+ta zhes so// me shel kyang shel shin tu dngas pa bsreg byed nyi ma'i rkyen dang phrad na me 'byung ba'o// sur+ya kān+ta zhes so//karka ta zhes pa ser bo ste ke ke ru zhes so// sbur len ni bzos ma ste kar smug gnyis so// ka pur pa ṇi zer ro//bya khyung skyugs pa ni khyung skyugs ste/ bya khyung gis nor bu rgya mtsho nas mid de skyugs par grags so// 'di la khra bo ni nges par dgos la/ dkar khra dmar khra/ ser khra/ sngo khra/ ljang khra las/ thams cad la gzhi dkar po lta bu la dkar po cung zad mi gcig pa'i khra yod pa ste/ da lta ljang khra mang bar snang ngo phra (khra1men ni phrang (phreng3ba'i rdog po lta bu la khra yod pa/ dkar khra/

ra'i+o/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 133ser khra/ dmar khra/ sngo khu/ ljang khra las/ gzhi dkar po la nag po'i khra dang / ser po la dmar po dang / dmar po la ser po dang / sngon po la dkar po dang / ljang gu la ser dmar gang rung gi khra yod pa ste/ darnalta dkar khra mang bas dkar khra men zer ro// ka shi la ni shel dkar po'o// spyir spa ṭi ka zer ro// yul skad du pha ṭi zer ro// —gzi ni dmar khra cung zad mog pa ste/ nag po dang dkar po spel ba shes (shas3che/ me tsa ka zer/mchong ni dmar po'o//me tog ni pu ṣa ra ga la zer/lce spyang gi ra (rwa3dang /sbrul gyi nor bu ni/ dbang ril dang ra turwa1ste/ srog chags de la 'byung bar dkon pas nor bu'o// ku sha bhan+da dung g.yas 'khyil/ gser len 'ga' zhig byi la mig la 'dod kyang 'dir ser dngas tumadangasakadakar mdangs yod pa'o//reg gcod ni rin po che shin tu ro tsha ba zhig go/gla ba'i nor bu ni de'i dbang ril lo//nya sogs kyi klad pa'i nang du byung ba'i rdo ba char 'bebs ni rdo'i rigs kyi nor bu'o//chu tshan ring bsrel skeni chu tshan mkhris skyo'akhrisopyosu 'byung ba'i rdo dkar ring bsrel 'dra ba'o/ 'ju byed shel rdo ni ze tsha 'dra ba'i shel lo//'khar ba la kam pa zer/ra gan la pho rag mo rag gnyis/ ming se te la re ta zer/ yul skad du/

134 sku'i+okhyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/ tar zer/ li dkar nag ni zha nye dkar nag ste/ nag po la zha nye dang ra nye zer/ ku ru bhid+dha/ nā ga shi sha tra su ṣa/ rnams zer ro// mtshan mo steng (lding3yang zer/ dkar po sha dkar ste/ mtshan mo lding yang zer/ ram gzer/ yul skad du borga zer ro// gzhan yang dzā hū rū pa gser sa le sgram dang / nī la mthon ka dang / ma hā nī la mthon ka chen po dang / hi ra ṇa dang / ba su dbyig dang / shi la man shel dang / mu sā ra ga wa spug dang /asma gar+gha rdo'i snying po dang / kā tsa ka mchin bu dang / nā la nal dang / ka sirta ka mgron bu ste/ yul skad du ka lbu ka zer ba rnams so//gnyis pa rdo sman la/ sbal rgyab rdo smug po 'od yod pa yin la/ pho sbal dang / mo sbal gnyis las/ pho sbal rgyab 'jam pa dang / mo sbal 'brum pa can no// dkar po sbal rgyab ni/ mdog dkar ba 'brum pa can zhig go/dkar po chig thub ni rdo dkar po cung zad snyi ba zhig go/srug po chig thub ni rdo smug po snyi ba'o// gangs thig (thigs3ni rdo sman ro cung zad mdog dkar ba'i ska (bska1ba zhig go/khab len la/ 'gugs byed/ gcod byed/ 'bigs byed/ bskor byed bzhi yod la/ ming a yi skam bha zer/ yul skad du tsusba ka zer ro//be+e snabs ni mu sa rdo dkar bo 'dra ba zhig go/ man 'dzir tumadz+nyarakani rdo smug nag zhig go/phag mgo dang byi mgo ni rang rang gi dbyibs 'dra ba'o//ser tugaser1rdo ni rdo ser po zhig ste/ ming po na ma k+ṣi zer/ tshodangul rdo ni rdo dkar sngo'i mdog dngul 'byung ba ste/ ming ru pa mā k+ṣi zer/stag tustang3zil ni tang rtsa rog po yin pa 'dra/ gser zil dang dngul

sku'i+o/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 135zil yang mdog gis phye bas/ gser zil mdog ser‘ba bcag ngams (ngam1'od phrom phrom yod pa/ dngul zil dkar sngo bcag ngams (ngam3'od phrom phrom yod pa'o//gru bzhi ni pho rog sho ste/ kha cig lig bu mig dang don gcig par 'dod kyang min no//cog la ma ni rgya mtshal lo//rdo klad ni rdo sman klad pa skams pe 'dra'o// li khri ni 'dir rdo sman khongs su mdzad/ li khri'i mdog 'dra ba'i rdo'o//da lta'i li khri ni gzos tshon ba sman rdu gtogs so//rdo mkhris kyang mkhris pa gser mkhris kyi mdog 'dra ba'i rdo'o//ldong ros ni rdo dmar ser btul na mdog ser ngur 'byung ba'o// ming ma na shi la zer/ yul skad du ma ni tshwa la zer ro//ba bla ni dngos so// ming ha ri ta la zer/rdo sol ni rdo nag po sol ba 'dra ba chu thor na khol bar 'gyur ba'o//ba nu ni ba'i nu ma 'dra ba'i rkang can dri dugs pa/ yul skad du rdo phyen po che zer/ti tre skyotsha1ser po ni rdo ser po bcag ngams (ngamakye'od dkar po phrom phrom yod pa bzhu na ti tsa (tsha3dkar po 'byung zer ro//mtshal ni dngos te/ ming bu la zer ro//lig bu mig la ngos 'dzin mi gcig pa snang yang / rgyud 'dir mdung rtse la mdzad par byung ste/ mdung rtse zur du ma smos pas so// 'di la mdung rtse dkar dmar nag gsum la/ mdung rtse'i skad dod sam sarje da zhes pa yod cing / lig bu mig gi skad dod so so trartsen zer bas rnam grangs su byed dgos so//

136 ༄7khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/tsag yug (btsag yugs3ni treg (btsagakaste/ dmar ser smug pa 'byung la/ ming ge ri ga zer/ yul skad du ge ge ru zer ro//cong zhi la rigs lnga yod kyang mo cong 'jam par byed/ ming shi lo da ka zer ro// —rdo thal ni rdo zhun te/ dkar po lug gdong 'dra ba/ nag po char sprin 'dra ba'am kyung (skyung1 kha'i rgyab 'dra ba/ sngon po phug ron ske 'dra ba/dmar po rta'i glo ba 'dra ba/ khra bo go bo'i rgyab 'dra ba dang lngar byed do//ha shig ni thod le kor te/ ming kha ṭi ka zer ro//rdo bye mgo'i skad dod u li ṭa bhe da yin zhes kha gcig 'dod/mtshal dkar la ṭam ka ra k+ṣa ra ṇa zer/ yul skad du ṭam ka ṇa khā ra zer ro// sbang ma latud+dha ka zer ro//ba bla'i ming gi rnam grangs a gasti yang zer/rdo brag la shi le ya zer/ tsa mis/ brag zhun tu bsgyur/zangs rdo la tā mā mā k+ṣi zer/ rdo spyi la/ u sra la/ mā k+ṣi/ asma zer/yul skad du tha ras khan zer ro// rjes (rjekyerang byung pas sa sman dang rdo sman lhan du bshad do//de nas khams rnams brjod bya ste/ khab len rigs ni rnam pa bzhi/'gugs byed lcags rnams 'gugs pa'o// gcod byed 'bigs byed skor byed rnams// lcags kun las byed khams mchog yin// mtshal gyis rtsa sbyang dug nad sel// gser dngul rdo ba de nyid mtshungs// zangs rdo mthing spangs nad kun skyug/ rag rdos mig gi rab rib sel// ti tsha dmar nag chu ser skems// pha wang dkar po mig la phan// nag po gru bzhi khyi smyon sman//gser zil zangs dang nus pa mtshungs// dngul zil rdo dug sel bar byed//ldong rus (ros1gag pa'i sman mchog yin// ba bla gdon nad sel bar byed//

༄༅/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 137mu zi mdze dang chu ser skoms// nag po lhag pa'i nad la phan// mu ljang gnyan tshad sel bar byed// mtshur nag rigs gsum gang gis kyang // dbyig dug sel zhing kha nad 'joms// dar mtshur rus nad phal cher 'joms// lhang tsher dug nad kun sel byed// khams brgyad nye bcud bcur bcas yin//'di rnams so sor dug bsad gces// de nas rdo gzhan yon tan ni// dung 'dra dngul chu 'ching bar byed// sprug po mo mgo nad kun phan// byed (bye1mgo mgo yi rus chag sbyar// sbal rgyab chungaser nad kun phan// mdung rtse dkar smug mig nad sel// dkar po gcig thub nus tshad sel// gangs thig (thigasana'abrum pa'i chu ser skem// 'brug klad klad pa'i nad la phan//cong zhis rus pa dngas ma gso// de ltar bcu po mgo chags dang // rma nad rus chags kun la phan// rdo zhos snod kyi nad rnams sel// phug ron ske yis lcags dreg 'joms// dkar po lug gdong skran la phan// rta glo kha 'dras 'dril rnams bshig/ skyung kha rgyab 'dra grang skran phan// ser pos mchin dri'i 'dril rnams sel// go bo'i rgyab 'dras grang skran 'jigs('jig1/ tsha rdos grang nad phal cher 'joms// rdo sol dbyig gi dug la phan// mu zi rdo bas dmu chu skems// 'di bcu bsregs la btang bar bya// rdo mkhris mkhris pa mig ser sel// rdo skyur bad kan grang ba sel// rdo rgyus rgyus pa'i nad la phan// lung rdos rtsa yi nad rnams sbyong // be snabs rma yi nad la phan// chu rdos tshad pa'i nad sel byed// brag rdos grang ba sel ba yin// rdo chu dngul kyi dug la phan// rgya mtsho tumatsho'ikyelbu bas gdon nad sel// thod le dkor (kor1gyis rtsa lam sel// 'di bcu grogs dang sdeb pa gces// rdo yos 'dus pa'i nad la phan// khar khu'akhar3gong srin can so srin sel// rgya tsha'i dro bas srin la phan// yugs kyis rma yi chu ser skems// ka shi'i rdos kyang dngul chu sbyongs// dngul chu'i rdo bsreg sha ro gcod// dug shel dug nad

138 ༄7ོkhyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/sel ba yin// mdzeng gis rma rnying sel bar bshadaka las byed 'du ba snyoms pa yin// yam pa khams gang yin pa mthun// sna tshogs nus ldan rdo ba bcu//gzhan yang ro nus 'dres pa rnams// nus pas nad rnams zhi byed pa//mkhas pas tshul bzhin dpyad byas la// gtong lugs mkhas pa'i zhal la dris//zhes gsungs pas/ti tsha la dkar nag gnyis su mdzad pa dang /pha wang la dkar nag gnyis su mdzad pa dang /mu zi la ser nag gnyis/ mu ljang la gsum du mdzad pa'i mu ljang ni mu zi byin las mdog cung zad ljang ba gnyan nad lhag pa sel ba zhig go/ de rnams kha dog gi khyad par du snang la/mtshur nag la rigs gsum du mdzad pa dang /lhang tsher la dkar ser dmar sngo nag po lngar bye nas/ ming badz+ra a ba/ma tru kyi a ba/ bhe ga a ba zer ba bzhed/dung 'dra zhes pa dung gi dbyibs 'dra ba'i rdo dkar zhig yongs (yong3zer ro//'brug klad ni rgyud 'dir bstan pa'i rdo klad dang gcigamu zi'i rdo ba bye brag tu bshad/rdo skyur zhes pa rdo ro skyur ba ste/ de gang du yod par chu yang ro skyur bar 'gyur ba zhig ste/ ming thu thu ka yang zer/rdo rgyus ni cung zad mkhreng ba'i sul can gcig dang / bya bal ma shin tu 'bol ba gnyis te/ gnyis ka mdog dkar ba'o//lung rdo dang chu rdo dang brag rdo ni grags par zad do//rdo chu la skad cig 'bigs pa/ zhag la 'bigs pa/ zla bar 'bigs pa/lo bar 'bigs pa/ lo skor gcig la 'bigs pa lngar bshad la/ rgya gar du

༄7/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 139chu bsgal (brgalakyebs rkang ba gang nubardor 'gyur bar yod zer ro| rgya mtsho (mtsho'i1lbu ba ni dngos rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram nas byung ba ṣadog ser nag bcad ngams tungam1bu gu tug1can bskos kyang lenatshopa mnan na nem byed pa/ slar yangartsosngar mal du ldang ba ste/ cung zad dkar ba zhig kyang snang ngo // ming sa mu tra ye na zer/rdo yos zhes pa rdo yos 'dra ba la betags/dkar gong srin ni grags par zad/ yugs ni tsag (btsag1yugs dang don gcig pa 'dra /ka shi'i rdo ni rdo dkaro po khar 'ju ba zhigo go/dngul chu'i rdo ni rdo dngul chu 'byung ba zhig yod par snang /dug shel ni shel gyi nus pas dug sel ba zhig go/ ji mdzeng ni grags pa'o// las byed ni byed las la btags pas/ yam pa ni sa/ chu me rlung dang masbrun pas dbye ba bzhi las/ 'dir sa'i khams dang mthun pas myag steganyid dkar ma'o//gsum pa sa sman la/ gser gyi bye ma ni sa sman bye ma 'a dra ba mdog ser ba zhig go/ dhesirtsa ra ni li khri'o// ze tsho ni bzos tsha ste rgyu ba rgya tsha/bro ba las byung bas sa sman du bstan no//de yang rje zur mkhar ba'i tsha (tshwa3bzo bdud rtsi me long las/ gyang rnying rmang gi sa nag ni// snum phol rgya tsha'i ro ldan ni/ rtsib ngos tsha tutshwa3'dra lce 'bigs shing // mer bsreg tsha tsha 'phro ba ste// brgyad 'gyur chu bsres lhog tsam bkol(bskol1/ / zhags (zhag1gsum bzhag pa dngas mas sings//sa rdul snyig (snyigs3ma ma 'dres pa// de dag nyung ngur so so bsdu// thigs gcig rdo grang steng du blug/ khyag tu'akhyag3pa lta bur gyur tshe bab(phab3/ /

140 ༄༅khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/ —nang bar blang la chu grang gis// bkrus skam rin chen ze tsha'o// zhes pa ltar ro// ya bak+ṣa ra ni lo tshu ba rnams kyis nas 'tshig 'khus pa'i thal bar bsgyur la/ de yang tshig 'gyur ya ba nas/ju k+ṣa ra 'gyurmer ba ste nas kyi 'gyur bar 'gyur ba/ don 'gyur du mdzad la/ nas 'gyur ba ste yos las byung ba dang /nas 'tshig 'khus pa yang nas tshig pa yos de 'khus pa'i thal ba snyi nag mar 'gyur ba 'dra zhig snang la/ zla zer rtsa 'grel las/ nas 'tshig 'khus pa'i lan tshwa ni// skran dang snying nad skya rbab dang // pho ba mtsher ba lkog nad dang //lud pa gzhang 'brum dbugs mi bde// lto sbos bad kan sel ba yin// zhes bya ba lan tsha'i (tshwa'i3nang nas 'tshitshi lakhus pa'i thal ba'i lan tshwa ni skran nad bad kan gyi nad sel zhing 'dzoms pa yin no// su rtsi (rdzi3ka stsogs thal tsha kun/khri rab rno tsha zhing srin sel yang //khrag mkhris skyed byed smin byed la// gcod cing mi zhim rnam paru 'byed //nas 'tshig 'khus tsha kha bas na// mdog mdangs khu ba skra mig gnod ces bya ba la/— su rtsi (sardzi3ka la stsogs pa'i thal ba'i tshekhu ba ni rab tu rno ba dang tsha ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa dang / srin bu'i nad sel ba dang / yang ba dang /khrag dang mkhris pa skyed pa smin par byed pa dang / bad kan la stsogs pa gcod par byed pa dang / de bzhin du mi zhim pa ste/ snying dga' bar mi byed pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa ste/ 'brum bu dang / phol mig la stsogs pa 'byed cing 'gags par byed pa dang / lan tsha skyitshwa3bro zhing kha bas na mdog mdangs dang khu ba la stsogs pa la gnod pa yin no// zhes dang / k+ṣa ra ni swa rdzi ka dang / ya bag tubakak+ṣa (ra )las tul3stsogs pa'o// zhes gsungs bya bas nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba tsha ba dang / su rtsi tusardzikaka kha bar bshad cing / k+ṣa ra la/ sa rtsi (rdzikyeka dang / ya ba k+ṣa ra gnyis su gsungs pas/

sku'i+o/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nusazhu rjes bstan pa/ 141gnyis ka k+ṣa ra'i bye brag yin yang mi gcig par snang la/ da lta su rtsi (rdzi1ka snye nag ma la byed snang bas/ cung zad ma mthun zhing / rgyud 'di'i dgongs pas sman du bshad pas/ ya ba k+ṣa ra brag skyibs kyi bul tog 'dra ba de nyid la 'dod dgos so| yul skad du dza ba khā ra zer ba zur chag pa yin no//bul tog ni dngos so// mu zi la ser nag gnyis su dbye/ ming la ghad+dha ka ste dri can dang / rgudha dang / pirnya shel rdo ser po dang / ma yurdzo ra shi kha ste rma bya'i gtsug phud rnams so//nag tshur dang ser tshur grags par zad do// big pan ni skabs 'di cong zhi bsregs pa 'dra ba'i sa sman ro shin tu tsha ba zhig go/ rdo dreg ni pha bong sogs la chags pa'i dreg pa ste/ dkar/ ser/dmar/ sngo/ ljang ba lnga snang ngo // ming she le'o//brag zhun ni sngar bshad pa ltar las/ ming shī la dzā rur zer/ rībazhi pa shing sman la/ rtsa ba sogs las/ dper na a ru ra'i rtsa bas rus pa'i nad sel ba/ sdong bos sha'i nad sel ba/ yal gas rtsa rgyus kyi nad sel ba/ shun pas pags pa'i nad sel ba/ lo mas snod kyi nad sel ba/ me tog gi dbang po'i nad sel ba/ 'bras bus don snying gi nad sel ba dang /'dus pa'i nad sel ba lta bu'o// rje rang byung pas/ de nas shing sman bshad par bya// a ga ru nag srog rtsa dang // snying gi tshad rlung thams cad sel// du ru ka yang rlung nad sel// a ga ru dmar rlung tshad 'joms// su ru tsan —dan de dang 'dra// tsan dan dkar po dri ldan gyis// bcud byed dri med tshad kyang sel// dmar pos khrag rlung 'thab pa 'joms// smug po tshad nad kun la phan// dhe ba dha rus tshad pa sel// u dum lnga ra bcud chen yin/ a shwa da ta
