༄༅/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 151so ma ra dza ni/ lho mon nas 'byung ba'i 'brus ('bras1bu che chung la phug gi sa bon tsam la/ dbyibs mkhal ma 'dra zhing pags pa la ne le'i ri mo yod pa de'o// shing mya ngan med pa'i 'bras bu la 'dod pa dang / rta srad ma'i 'bru la byed pa ni nor ba'o// ming bod skad du zla ba'i rdul/ tsan+d+ra re kha ste zla ba'i ri mo/ irtsu ra dza ste zla ba'i tuzla tshes kyikardul/ so ma ba l+li ka ste zla ba'i bcug (lcug3ma/ sikhyi mū la grub kyi rtsa ba/ yul skad du baṅgā yang zer ro//tri bha wan yang zer/ te ma ra/ mdze 'joms/ gha tim ra yang zer ro//tha khuthal3dkar (ka3rdo rje ni/ pho rigs mo rigs gnyis las/ pho rigs 'bras bu ser ljong ('jong3'jam po yod pa'o/ ming e ṭi zer ro//mo rigs pho mtshan 'dra ba'i tri (kri3ka can no// i shwa ra lirga zer ro//'dis srid 'phel bar byed/ 'dzo (dzo1gi rnams tshis (rtsisakyeshin tu che'o//gser gyi me tog ni shing dang skud pa sogs (la ) 'khris nas skye ba'i sgang bu'i nang nas 'byung ba ste/ ming he ma puṣ+ṭha/ gsor mgo gzong chung /so na puṣ+ṭha zer ro// pa to la 'di dang gcig par 'dod pa mi 'thad do// kha cig tu tit+ta sa ro li zer ba'ang snang ngo //gser gyi phud bu ni gser gyi me tog las chung tsam gyi mdog nag po sbur ba bcar ba lta bu'o//dug mo nyung la rgod g.yung gnyis las/ lho mon nas 'byung ba'i 'bras bu che ba rgod bsil/ bod du 'byung ba'i 'bras bu chung ba g.yung drod do//ming ku ṭa dza/ in+d+ra yab (ya baṃ3ste dbang bo'i nas/ in+d+ra dza ba/ ba ts+tshakasu mu kha/ bzhin bzang / ku ṭa dza'i sa bon/ in+d+ra dbang po/ brgya byin zer ro// in+d+ra dug nyung / srog chags grog ma/ dbang lag lha'i dbang bo rnams la 'jugs ('jug3pa'i skabs yod pas skabs thob shes par bya'o//rgun 'brum la mchog dang / shang ma gnyis/ mchog ni 'phags yul

152 ༄༅khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/dang / tsha ba rongs nas 'byung ba'i ro mngar ba ste/ yan lag brgyad par/rgun 'brum 'bras bu'i mchog yin te// ro tsa mig phan bshang gci sla//mngar zhing zhu rjes snum pa dang // cung zad ska (bska3 zhing bsil la lci//rlung dang khrag mkhris sel byed cing // kha nang kha bro chang nad dang // skom lud cham rims dbugs mi bde// skad 'dzer glo rdol glo gcong sel// zhes gsungs pas so// de la yang kha dog gi dbye bas dkar nag gnyis so// shang ma ni yul gzhan du skye ba'i ro skyur ba'o// ming drag zer/ yul skad du du dā gha zer ro//'u su ni/ ming dha rgyo zer/ yul skad du dha ni ya zer/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 'grel ba slob dpon bha wa bha dras mdzad par/ 'u su ni 'u su'i me tog ste/ de nyid bshad pa ni sha da puṣ+ṭha'o zhes bshad/ dus 'khor du am ga ni sha da puṣ+ṭha'o/ zhes 'byung pas/ sha da puṣ+ṭha ste me tog rgyas pa/ sha ta am ga ste yan lag brgyad par/ sha ta a hu dus r+ya ste ming can/ ma si rnams 'u su'i ming gi rnam grangs so// zla zer las sha ta puṣ+ṭhani ma si'o// zhes bshad pas gong gi rnams 'u su'i ming gi rnam grangs su nges shing shu ti sha ta puṣ+ṭha'o zhes zla zer las bshad pas sha ta puṣ+ṭha'i rigs su 'u su dang shu ti gnyis bsdus so//star bu la rgyu shing la pho mo gnyis/ pho 'bras bu med pa'i bla (gla1ba dang /mo 'bras bu yod pa'i star mo gnyis las/ 'dir phye (phyi1ma'i 'bras bu bzang zhing / spyir ming du shing nag go/ 'di'i ro nus rjes la/ rgyu sa me las byung ba sogs kyi nus pa drod du sgrub pa ni skyu ru ra la'ang mtshungs pa sgres na zhib mo'i lan 'don dgos snang / 'on kyang star bu'i nus pa la khrag 'ju ba yod pas dro ba yod nges so// 'phrad tu'aphral3skad du/ tsu ka zer/bse yab la pho rigs (rgod ) dang / mo rigs g.yung gnyis las/dang po lho mon nas 'byung ba'i 'bras bu smug po/ rtse gu rme ru rtse 'dra ba yod

༄༅/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 153pa'o// gnyis pa mdog dmar skya rtse gu 'jong mo bzhi sgrom yod pa bod du'ang skye ba'o//se 'bru la/ kha che'i se 'bru/ mon gyi se 'bru/ khams kyi se 'bru gsum las/ snum la ro skyur ba bzang bas dang po rab/ gnyis pa 'bring / gsum pas tshab rung tsam mo// ming dā ṭi ma zer/ yul skad du dā ṭi ma zer/gzhan pha la tag dang ma hu ta zhes kyang zer ro//na le sham la/ dkar nag gnyis las/ dkar po la shi kru dang / sa du ban dzi na zer/ spyi ming du pho ba ril/ yul skad du ma ri tsa (tsi1zer/ ming gzhan drod sman hril mo/ ma ri tsi/ pho tshe rnams zer ro// na le sham ni gab ste bod skad yin zhes lo tsa (tsā3ba dag bzhed do//pi pi ling la mo rigs dang / pho rigs gnyis las/ dang po phra zhing grog sked 'dra ba bzang / ming pi spa la/ nag po tshan de/ drod sman 'jong mo/spod nar/ sman nag tsha ba zer/ gnyis pa pho rigs ni/ snga ma las sbom pa'i ring thung sor bzhi tsam yod pa'o// ming ga ja pi spa la zhes pa glang po'i pi pi ling zer ro//sman sga/ sga skya zhes pa la/ sga la dbye na/ dkar po/ dmar po/ sga gsher dang gsum/ dang po la sman sga dang / sga skya gnyis/ dang po bca' sga gcig ste/ ming shu rī dang / shrirga be+e ra zer/ gzhan yang ke la sga/ bi sho be sha/ bca' sga zer ro// gnyis pa ni/ mdog skya la cung zad sha chung ba'o//gnyis pa dmar po la/ ming arnya zer ro// spyi ming yul skad du shuṇ+ḍi dang a ta zer ro// tsi tra ka ni/ skug lo dril ba lta bu'i phyi rim nang rim mang po yod pa dmar khams tukham1cung zad yod pa/ ro shin tu tsha ba mon pa tro sogs nas skud pa la dkyus (nas ) khyer yong ba 'di yin la/ iglu dang / ban+ni dang /

154 ༄༅khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/trug trug tros rnams ming —gi rnam grangs so// trug trug tres ni bod skad de gab bo//shing tsha ni shing kacutukañtsa3tha'i shun pa ste/ dngos dang / rjes mthun pa gnyis/ dang po srab la mdog dmar ba ro tsha ba'o// ming ta khutra3tsa dang /twag (tra kra1dang / twats+tsha (trats+tsha3rnams zer/ yul skad du ta tse zer ro//gnyis pa rjes mthun pa ni/ 'thug cing rgyab skya ba ro tsha shas chung ba ni da tudwakatsha ba'o// sman ngo gsal byed du wa tshar mdzad kyang min no//shing kun ni/ sman ngo gsal byed du shing gi thang chur bshad/ 'ga' zhig shing sdong pags pa bshus pa'i bar du sha chen bcug nas zhag bdun bzhag pa dang / sha chen gyi drod kyis shing bcud rnams bsdus pa'i khu ba sgor bar 'dod/ gang na'ang dkar po dri dang ldan pa bzang / sgog pa sogs kyi lhad yod pa'i mdog dmar ser sogs mi rung ngo // ming hing gu ste rtsi bo che/bok+ka na ste/ dus 'khor las bok+ka na zhes pa shing kun te gang srad bu sngon po la byugs na dkar po byed pa'o// zhes pas so// yul skad du hi gu zer/ gzhan yang shing ku ma/ spor tuspod3chen so(dri chen no3/ / gnod sbyin rkang mar rnams kyang zer ro//byi tang ka la/ bi ṭa ṅga zer ro//rme ru rtse la dkar dmar gnyis mdog gis phye/ dkar po'i ming la shed tushī takaguñdza zer/ dmar po la ming / rak+ta guñdza dang / srin po (bu1dmar leb zer/ gnyis ka dbyibs bye'u (bye'u'i3mchin pa 'dra ba'o//spos dkar ni gu gul dkar po ste/ ngo bo thang chu yin la/ 'di la stod nas 'byung pa'i si la yang zer/ rta so ma yang zer ba gcig dang / lho mon nas 'byung bro'i spos dkar dkyus ma gnyis/ snga ma mchog yin la/ phyi mas tshab yorung ngo // si la spos sbyor la dri khyad par du gyur pa zhig yong ba dang

༄7/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 155'di'i si la ni mi gcig go/ ming a tā la zer/ phra tu'aphralakaskad du/ ra la zer ba zur chag go/gu gul la shing las byung ba/ srog chags las byung ba/ yul khyad par ba las byung ba gsum/ dang po ni/ shing 'dre 'jigs kyi thang chu yin zer/ming gug+gu la ste/ zur chag pas gul tugu3gul zer/ yul skad du/ gu gu la/gzhan yang 'dre 'jigs thang chu/ bgegs sprod/skrod3/ klu dug pa/ gsod byed spyang ku nag po/ rdzas kyi phyag rdor/ 'dre gsod zer/ gnyis pa srog chags las byung ba'i gu gul ni ma he las byung pa ste/ yul skad du bha yi sha gu gul zer/ gsum pa yul khyad par ba las byung ba ni/ ā pa wa ri nas byung pa ste/ yul skad du ā pa wa ri gu gul zer ro//shel ta ni som gyi thang chu'o//rgya tsha ni rdo las byung ba'i tsha (tshwa1sna ste/ ming dzā hwa bhin+da ste lce 'bigs par byed pa zer/ yul skad du ā samyu ri la ṇa (saṃ pi ri lo ṇa3zer/ gzhan yang / rdo'i dngas ma/ chu'i snying po/ regs khureg3'bigs/ chu 'bigs rnams zer ro//rgyam tsha ni rgya mtsho las byung ba ste/ shel ltar dngas pa ro mngar cha che ba bzang / ming sidha wa ste/ rgya mtsho las byung ba dang / sin+t+ra la ba ṇa tusirgyu lo war+ṇa1ste rgya mtsho'i tsha (tshwa3zer/ yul skad du sarnyo lo lo ṇa (sorla lo na3zer ro//lce myang tsha ni/ stod nas 'byung ba'i shing sman dmar mkhregs ro tsha ba zhig ste/ sman ming rgya mtshor/ lce myang tsha ni yal ga'i sde/ zhes dang / bdud rtsi 'byung khungs las/ lce myang tsha zhes bya ba'i sman// lho rong tshad pa'i yul du skye// sdong bo phyi skya nang ni dmar// lo ma sgor chung tsher ma can// yal ga ring ldem me tog ser// ro ni tsha ber do ba 'draka rang gi nus pas grang nad sel//tsha ba mi skye rlung la phan// zhes shing sman du bshad pas sospyo

156 ༄cukhyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/kha ru tsha ni bzos tsha tutshwa3ste// byang tsha shel 'dra cha drug la// bul tog phyed dang gnyis kyi phye// zhib btags zhi kha'i kong bur blug/ sol mes bsregs pa'i zhun mar bya// tsha la bsregs pa cha phyed dang // rgya tsha bzang po cha gsum ste// g.yag rgod ra khurwa1gzhob cha bzhi rnams// brgyad 'gyur chu bkol (skol3dngas ma sings// de nas gong gi tsha zhun bzhu// bsdus la btab pa kha ru tsha'o//zhes tsab ru tsha yang bzos tsha (tshwa3ste// byang tsha sngo chags cha lnga la// tsha la bzang po cha gsum ste// rgyam tsha ze tsha tshur dkar gsum// phye btags bzhus pa tsab ru tsha// zhes pa ltar ro//rwa tsha yang bzos tshwa ste/ g.yag rgod ra lugs (lug3rna ba'i rwa// cha mnyam ser bsregs phye ma dang // byang tsha lhad med cha mnyam la// rang nub tsam gyi ba chu dang // brgyad 'gyur chang bsres dkrug cing btso// de la rgyam tsha tsha la dang // bul tog cung zad kha tshar gdab// zan tsam gyur tshe gong po bya//rnan srab mo'i nang du bzhug(gzhug1/ rwa rtse kha bcad zla me mur// zhag cigasum sbangs pa rwa tsha'o// zhes pa ltar ro// gal te de lta bu ma grub na tshab ma yang rung ste/ de ma grub na mgar ba yi// tho so ngar blud tsha zhun gyis// tshab ma rung zhes bla mas gsung // zhes pa ltar ro/thal tsha yang bzos tshwa ste/ be+e dang seng ldeng la sogs pa// tsher can shingagi 'tsher jitsher1ma dang // pags pa bsregs thal cha gnyis la// sbyar ba'i lpags thal cha gcig gis// bsres pa'i thal 'jim ('jam1sor lnga tsam// sle'u 'am 'thags ngan steng du blug/ snyug gzeb nang du snyoms par bting // de nyid khri steng gzhag byas la// chu gtsang thal 'jim ('jam1ma 'khyugs bran// 'og tu snod gtsang gzed byas la// mar nag lta bu'i thigs pa 'byung // gong bzhin bsdus grang thal tsha'o// zhes pa ltar ro//

༄༅/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nusazhu rjes bstan pa/ 157mdze tsha ni/ stod nas 'byung ba'i kha ba sgongs pa lta bu bzang / ya bak+ṣa ra rgan pos kyang tshab rung ngo //tsha la la/ ming dar tshul(tshur3/ zangs rtsi/ rma 'byor/ shel rtsi zer ro// lba tsha ni stod nas 'byung ba'i bag phye dra ba'i ro ba tsha bro ba zhig ste/ ba tshas kyang tshab ma rung ngo //a ru ra la/ ming ha ri ta ka dzi wan+ti rā dzā ste 'tsho byed rgyal po/ hu ti ra/ shing gi lha mo/ e la 'jigs med/ shing gi nor bu/ sman mchog rgyal po/a mo gha ste don yod pa/ a bha ya ste 'jigs med/ a bya dha nad med pa/ a mṛ ta ste bdud rtsi rnams so// dbye ba la/ rnam rgyal/ 'jigs med/ bdud rtsi/ 'phel byed/ skem po dang lnga/ dang po ni phya tshan ku ba'i mjug ma ltar zhabs cung zad skyong ba'o// ming bi dza ste rnam par rgyal ba'o// 'di'i rjes mthun pa ni gser mdog ste/ mdog ser zhing zur brgyad pa rtsa ba cung zad zlum pa'o// ming gser mdog gser mdog zur mangs/ gser sgong zur mangs so// gnyis pa 'jigs med ni/ 'bigs byed nag chung du grags pa'o// gsum pa bdud rtsi ni/ a ru ra sha 'thug pa/ lho mon nas 'byung ba'o// bzhi ba 'phel byed ni/ dbyibs bum pa ltar zlum pa'o// lnga pa skem po ni/ a ru sha skems shing sul mang ba'o//ba ru ra la/ chung ba skya na bzang / ming ba (ma1hi ḍa dang / bi bhi ta ka dang / ba hu lbu khuwu3ra zer/ la lar wa san+ta zer/ sum+bha ḍar (saṃ pu ṭi las3/ bleṣ+ṭha'i 'bras bu zer ba bod kha cig gis ba ru rar bsgyur/ man ngag snye mar de ni bad kan mthar byed de wa hu ra zhes bshad pas ba ru rar don mthun no// phra ('phral3skad du bha bi ḍa zer/ dol bor pa la ha/ gru gur tri sha go la/ rgya nag tu hang ze'u/ gab tu shing sgong skya bo zer ro//

158 rgukhyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/skyu ru ra la/ dkar dmar gnyis las/ dkar ba sha che ba bzang /ming asla dang / a mṛ todzha wa ste bdud rtsi las byung ba dang / dhā dri zhes pa skyu ru ra'i sdong bo dang / yul skad du skyu ru ra la asmra la zer/ gzhan yang so ma si la/ dza mu sha dha tusku ṭa/ rmin (smin3'gas/ skom sel/ khrag 'byed zer ro// yan lag brgyad par/ skyu ru ra a ru ra dang nus pa 'dra ba las bsil ba dang / ba ru ra de las cung nus pa dman par bshad de/ skyu ru ra yang de 'dra bsil// ro skyur bad kan mkhris pa sel// yon tan kun dman ba ru ra// zhu rjes tsha mngar skra mig phan// 'bras bu gsum po 'di dag ni//bcud kyi len mchog mig nad sel// rma 'tsho lpags tupags3nad rma red dang // tshil chen gcin snyi bad khrag sel// snying zho sha la/ ming asba li zer/ mkhal ma zho sha la/ dkar nag gnyis kyi dkar snum mkhregs pa bzang / nag po yang nus pa mtshungs so//gla gor zho sha ni/ glang gi mig 'bras sam mchin pa lta bu/ ming sha luṅga /sha lu na dang / pū ga pha la zer/ yul skad du sgor pha la zer ro//a 'bras ni sman ngo gsal byed du/ sha 'bras la bzhed kyang / dbyibs zla gor zho sha 'dra ba'i pags pa khro bo yod pa ste/ a 'bras shing gi lca ba 'dra zhes pa'o// ming asba dang / bha hū ra yang zer ro//sra 'bras ni a ru ra'i rtsi gu lta bu las dkyil sbom zhing zur bzhi pa zur dod pa'o//bra go ni bra go'i 'bras bu ste go phye dang 'dra ba la mdog dkar ba'o//sman ngo gsal byed du bra go dang / go phye gcig par mdzad kyang ma yin te/ bra go char bshad pa'i phyir/ ming khadzi ra zer/ma nu pa tra ni ldum rar skye ba'o//spus dkar (puṣ+kar3sku la ni khams rus so//

༄༅/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 159ru rta la mchog dang phal ba gnyis/ dang po la/ nag po dang dkar po gnyis/ dang po ni dri dang ro tsha/ mdog nag dbyibs sha ra (rwa3rul pa 'dra ba ste sha pho ru rta grags so// gnyis pa ni/ dri dang ro mngar shas che/dbyibs ma nu pa tra 'dra/ mdog cung dkar ba ste ma nu ru rtar grags pa'o//rgya skad du pa ṭa ste pa tra zur chag pa'o// gnyis pa phal ba ni/ dri med ro kha tsha ldan pa skya sob ste khams rus su grags pa'o// ming kuṣ+ṭa ste mdze can zer/yul skad du kū ṭha (kuṣ+ṭha1zer ro// gzhan yang byā dha dang / ro ga dang / ruṇ+ḍa rnams nad can ste ru rta'i ming gi rnam grangs so//spu shel rtse ni/ gtsang shod du skye ba'i rtsa dkar po 'jag ma 'dra ba/ ga pur dri mnam pa ste/ ming u shi ra/ bi ra mu la/ rtsa (rtswa3ga pur zer ro//shu dag la dkar nag gnyis las/ dkar po la mchog dman gnyis/mchog stod nas 'byung ba bcad 'tshams (mtshams3dkar ba/ dri zhim pa/ro mngar kha/ mdog mdangs dang ldan pa ste/ bum sman/ khrus sman/ blo 'phel ba'i rdzas mchog tu bshad/ dman pa ni ldum rar skye ba'i rtsa ba'o//ming u tra ste drag po/ dza ya ste rgyal ba/ she ta a ra dzi ta ste gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po zer/ nag po ni them gnyer tsub cing dri ma che la dugs pa/ mi rgan gyi sor tshigs skam po 'dra ba ste/ ming he ru ka zer/ spyi ming bats+tsha dang sagran+d+ra (ṣagron+d+rakadang / he ma wa ti zer/ yul skad du/ ba tsha zer rokakhyung sder dkar po ni lho mon nas 'byung ba/ sngo sder mo bzhi ba'i dbyibs can mdog dkar po'o// khyung sder sprug po ni de nyid mdog smug po'o// dpa' bo dkar po ni/ ru ba de dang / rtsa ba la phug 'dra zhing dkar la sob khong spu yod pa'o//dpa' bo ser po ni/ me tog sngo rtsa ba ser la dugs/ skye lugs rgu drus

160 ༄7khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/'dra/dpa' rgod ni dpa' bo dkar po 'dra ba la khong spu med pa/ bcad ngams (ngam1mkhregs pa phreng ba dkyus pa ltar rdog po sgrongs pa yod pa'o//bong nga dkar po ni sman gyi bong nga dkar po ste/ ming a ti bi ṣa dang /pra ti bi ṣa zer/ yul skad du she ta nirbi shi zer ro//bong nga dmar po yang sman gyi bong nga dmar po ste/ yul skad du rak+ta nibi shi zer ro//shing mngar la/ pho mo ma ning gsum las/ pho ldum rar skye ba'i gser gyi lcug ma 'dra ba shing mngar du grags pa'o// mo chu 'gram sogs su skye ba'i 'jim ('jam3pa'o// ma ning shing khrod chu 'gram sogs su skye ba'i lpongs (wang1mo yang zer/ byi'i shing mngar yang zer ba de'o// spyi ming du/ mad+dha yakhyi dang / ma bhu dza khyi dang / sgyi ma mū la 'jigs byed kyi rtsa ba zer/ gzhan yang ca ram rtsi/ thim si/ wang tsi'u/ lce 'khril/ rtsar rgyug glo gnyen byed zer ro// sle tres ni zhang zhung gi skad du byams pa gling pa (parakabazhed kyang / gu ru rtsi zhes pa sle tres su bsgyur ba ltar na dpyad pa'i gzhi'o// gzhan yang ming a mṛ ta ste bdud rtsi dang / tshin+da (tshin+da3ru ha ste bcad skyes dang / wa ram (pi rī3ga ste ma chog gi lus dang / wa yasbra (yaṣ+ṭha3ste na tshod gnas zer ro//phyi ma'i skad dod a ru ra dang bya rog la'ang 'jug pas skabs thob shes dgos so//kan+ta ka ri zhes pa la/ rgya skad ma nyams pa kaṇ+ḍa ka ri yin pa la zur chag pas kan+ta ka ri'o//'di bshad na/ bṛ ha ti la dbye na srug po dang / dkar po gnyis/dang po ni bṛ ha ti dang / kasnya ka ri'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/

༄7ོ/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 161stag tsher ba zhes bya ste smug po'o// gnyis pa ni/ tsu dkar zhes bya ste dkar po'o// spyi ming du bya tri/ rak+ṣa ma/ 'dre shing zer/ ga gra 'di'i ming gi rnam grang (grangs3su 'dod kyang / thar nu dang / lca ba gnyis su sgyur bas mi 'thad do// ga gra dag kyang de bzhin no zhes pa thar nu la bzhed pa 'dra ste/rims sbyong byed yin pa'i phyir/tig ta yul gyis phye bas rgya tig bal tig bod tig gsum/ me tog gis phye bas zangs tig lcags tig gser tig dngul tig bzhi/'di'i gser tig pa ni gram tig pa'o// rigs kyis phye na tig ta dngos dang /sum cu tig gnyis/ dang po la me tog gis phye ba'i bzhi 'byung ba yin no//ming ngos /dngos1ni tig ta ste/ zur chag pas tig ta zer/ gzhan ju ni sba dang / kai ra ta ste mon skyes zer ro//ba sha ka la/ dmar dkar sngo ba gsum/ snga ma snga ma bzang / 'dab mas tshod ma rung / ming dngos ni bā sa ka zur chag pas ba sha kha zer/gzhan yang bā sha ka dang / bṛ ṣ+pe dang / bri ṣa dang / bri kha dang / marnya sar ni dang / bri ka sha dang / khrag skem gtso bo rnams zer/ba le kha ni shing sman gyi dbyi mong ltar shing gzhan la 'khris te skye ba/pags pa 'thugs pa ga bur gyi dri mnam pa zhig go/ ming ma ṇi bṛk+ṣa ste shing gi nor bu/ ka pur garnyin ste ga bur dri ldan/ ba la ka dang / ba li ka ni ming dngos te zur chag pas ba le ka'o//li ga dur la pho mo gnyis/ pho rigs mon bu skam po 'dra ba dang / mo rigs bya rog sug po 'dra zhes pa rtsa ba ste/ 'dab ma snga ma mon pa lta bu dang /phyi ma glang ma'i lo ma 'dra ba'o// ming bā na ste dang / u pal be ta dang / shel bhe de dang / asma ba ta dang / ku la na ṭa dang / na ga ti dang / 'be 'ja ra dang / 'khyog cing gar byed ces pa rnams so/ /

162 ༄khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa /stabs tustabakaseng ni spyi bzhur te/ ming be sa ra dang / tā ma la kashing sngon/ shing dkar rtsab mo/ lci (spyi1bsil/ gab la seng ge'o/ tshong dpon g.yu'i gsang chab can zer ro// rje rang byung pas shing sngon stabs (stab3seng spyi bzhur tha dad du bshad pas skabs shes dgos so//sgron shing ni/ thang ma sgron shing su (du3grags pa ste thang ma gor tsan yang zer ro// de yang de ba dā ru/ tsan+dan smug po dang / thang shing dang /lha'i shing dang / shug pa la bsgyur ba'i skabs mang du snang ba'i bshad pa byung ba la/ kha cig dgos pa med de don so so ba yin pas ngos ma zin pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir zer ba ni/ skad gnyis kyi rnam dbye ma chags pa ste/ sgra gcig don mang po la 'jug pa skabs thob shes dgos pa'i phyir/ de dag kyang bkas bcad nas gtan la phab pas/ bye brag rdog byed chen mor de ba dā ru thang shing la bsgyur bas thang shing la 'jug pa yang skabs thob kyi shes dgos so//des na de ba dā ri 'jam rtsi'i skabs lta bur byung na sgron shing / rlung tshad sel ba'i skabs su byung na tsan dan smug po dang / skabs gzhan du byung na shug pa dri ldan la byed dgos shing / lha'i shing ni dri zhim pas shug pa tsan dan de dang gcig go/ des na de ba dā ru yang sgron shing la 'jug pa'i skabs yod do//skyer ba la dkar nag gnyis/ ming dā ri ha ri 'dra/ gser shing / sa la ta ga dhi sha ri/ dzi byid ta/ tsher snon 'bras skyur rnams zer ro//seng ldeng la/ tsan+dan seng ldeng / skyer seng ldeng / som seng ldeng gsum gyi 'dir snga ma gzung / ming ha ta ra/ dzi wan drak+ṣa ste 'tsho byed shing /chu ser khrag 'thung / khu ba mdze 'dod tu'ajoms1rnams zer/so cha ni/ po so cha ste/ 'bras bu pags pa srab mo gnyer ma can phyi nang yod pa che chung kham bu skam po tsam pa/ mi rgan rlig pa 'dra ba de'o// ming ma dan pha la ste myos byed kyi 'bras bu pha la wā na yang zer ro//

༄༅/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 163dan rog ni/ sdong bo las 'bus zos pas dar gyi sgyu'i (rgyu'ikaskud pa 'dra ba zhig 'byung zer/ 'bras bu rus sbal 'dra ba'i che ba dang / kha phye nas 'byung ba'i nag chung 'jam pa gnyis yong snang ngo // ming dza yi sna la zer/ phra kyi'aphral3skad du dzā yi pā la zer ro//shrī khaṇ+ḍa ni/ bse dkar gyi zho ste/ 'bras phyes sbrus pa dang ma sbrus pa gnyis/ sbrus pa phab rdog 'dra ba'o// bsgyur na dpal gyi dum bu zer/gzhan yang ming k+shi ra dang / shrī ri sha zer ro//dong kha ni bshal sman thog can te/ ming karnyi ka rā/ rā dzi bri k+ṣa ste ljon shing rgyal bo/ a rak+ta she ma ka zer ro//ka ped la mo rigs pho rigs gnyis yod pa las/ mo rigs bil ba ste/bil ba ka ped du bsgyur bas so// 'di ni dbang dang bkra shis kyi rdzas la'ang dgos pa zhig go/ pho rigs bu chung gi thod pa 'dra ba kha dog dmar skya nang na 'brus ('bras3bu leb mor skyur bas gang ba'o// de'i ming bri had pha la/ a larū/ kā lbu rā dza su ti zer/ rtsi sman la skam rlon la nus pa mi gcig pa yod par snang ste/pi pi ling rlon pas bad kan skyed pa dang / skam pos bad kan sel bar bshad pa'i phyir te/ zla zer las/ pi pi ling rlon bad skyed rlung //bsil zhing lci la snum pa yin// zhes bya ba la/ pi pi ling rlon pa ni bad kan skyed cing ro mngar ba dang / nus pa bsil ba dang / lci zhing snum pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin no// skam po de las bzlog tuldog3pa yin// snum zhing ro tsa ro tsha la// zhu rjes mngar zhing bad rlung dang // lud pa dbugs mi bde sel 'khru// de gnyis bcud len ma gtogs pa// gzhan la shas cher sbyar mi bya// zhes bya ba la/ pi pi ling ste skam po yin na ni pi pi ling rlon pa de las yon tan go bzlog (ldogarikapa yin no// de la go bzlog (ldog3pa rlon pa ni

164 ༄7khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/bad kan skyed pa dang / mngar ba dang / lci ba yin la 'di ni bad kan sel ba dang / kha ba dang snum pa bsil ba dang yang ba yin no// de'i khyad par gzhan yang skam po ni ro tsa zhing khu ba 'phel ba dang zhu ba'i rjes mngar ba dang /de bzhin du bad kan dang / rlung dang lud pa dang /ri dbugs mi bde ba sel bar byed cing khong 'khru ba yin te/ de lta bu'i pi pi ling de ni bcud kyis len gyi cho ga ma gtogs par gzhan la zhes pa/ nad med par gnas pa dang nad pa dag gso ba'i skabs la shas cher sbyar bar mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pas so//bdun pa sngo sman la/ hong len ni rdo yul nas 'byung ba'i phyi 'jam zhing skya la bcag na du ba lta bu 'byung ba bzang la/ yul du skye ba'i phyi nag pa them gnyer rags pa ni cung ngan yang gnyis ka rung ngo // ming ni ro hi ṇi dang /spu rtse shel/ g.ya' rug ma zer/ pu shel rtse dang pu rtse shel ma nor ba gal che'o//spang rtsi do bo zhes pa la/ do bo spun gsum ste/ spang rtsi do bo/ nags rtsi do bo/ lug rtsi do bo/ dang po ni/ spang la 'byung ba 'dab ma 'od che ba nya ga cung zad me tog smug po can no// gnyis pa ni/ lo ma skya bun nya ga can/ me tog smug skya yod pa'o// gsum pa ni/ nag leb pa ste/ 'dab ma skya bun bun snga ma gnyis las che ba nya ga cung zad yod pa me tog smug sngon no// 'dir spang rtsi do ba ste/ ming be do la/ bi do bi ni/ ni bu chung / be do ba/ kun byed rgyal po/ o log ber kha/ bo bo mgo rnams zer ro//re skon pa ni/ 'khrungs dper/ re skon g.ya' dang chu rong skye// lo ma par pa ta dang mtshungs// zhes pas g.ya' dang chu rong la skye ba'i lo ma par pa ta 'dra ba la de bas cung che ba/ me tog ser ba zhig go/ sman ngo gsal byed du/ rtsi dmar rkang gcig rtsi dmar zil can/ phug ron rkang / zla ba'i dug sogs ming gi rnam grangs su mdzad/ rtsi dmar zil can gad logs la skye

༄༅/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nusazhu rjes bstan pa/ 165ba'i ra dug pa zer ba'i rkang dang lo ma la dmar ngams (ngam3yod pa zhig yong ba la ngos 'dzin byed mkhan 'dug pa/ de yin na ni gcig par mi snang ngo // 'on kyang re skon chu rong du skye ba nyid rtsi dmar rkang gcig gi tha snyad mi 'jug pa 'dra ste/ lag tu ma gyes pa mthong ba'i phyir/ des na rang lugs la lag mang so can re kon (skon3pa/ rkang gcig par skyes shing rkang shin tu dmar ba rtsi dmar zil yin no// sngo sman 'di rnams la zhib mor phye nas sngo nyid la brtag dgos par snang ngo //kyi lce ba la dkar nag gnyis las/ 'dir dkar po bzang zhing / ming she ka ku ṇa/ sha lang ba/ ku ka ra ṭa/ gnod sbyin lce/ shel gdang dkar zer/ nag po 'dzangs ma'o// dkar po la biju kran+ta/ ku karga zer/ spyi ming tra ya na/ tra ya mā na ste skyob byed kyang zer ro//sum cu tig ni go bar zad do//pri yang ku ni/ sngo 'dab ma skya la me tog sngo ba ste/ bod skad du 'jib rtsi zer ro// gzhan yang mchin sman a'u rtsi/ dre'u rngog pa/ dar sngon 'phyar ba/rtsi'u dri chen/ sngo nī lam/ ting le byin/ tri yang / bod kyi gur gum rnams zer ro//zangs tig me tog dmar po dang / lcags tig me tog sngon pos phye ba'o/sro lo sug 'dra zhes pa'i skabs su/ sro lo la dkar srug sug 'dra gsum/dkar po mchog yin yang sug 'dra dang glo tshad sel ba'i skabs su nus pa khyad med do// srug po cung dman no//g.ya' kyi ma ni rgyal bo zla bsil te/ gser kyi/ dngul kyi/ zangs kyi/lcags kyi zhes me tog gis phye/ lo ma gser gyi pa tra 'dra ba'i phra zhib 'od dang ldan pa'o// da lta skye ba ni me tog ser 'od kha shas che bar snang ngo //

166 ༄7khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/gangs ga (gaṅgā3chung ni/ zur bzhi logs brgyad rtse mo dpal dgu ldan pa gang dkar thel rtse yang zer ro//bya rgod spos la/ spos chen/ spos chung gnyis las/ spos chen gla rtsi'i dri mnam pa bzang ngo // ming bdud rtsi chig thub/ srin bya'i mgo bo can/ sngo ma gi ta/ sngo shig gsod/ gla rtsi'i dri can rnams zer ro// srol gong ba g.ya' spang 'tshams skyomatshams1su skye/ sdong bo khong stong / me tog dkar ser phra ba spung nas 'char/ lo ma phra la nya ga can dbyibs phrug so kha gyen du bstan pa lta bu/ ro shin tu kha ba zhig ste/ ming yu mo srol gong zer ro// sgrol mas mdzad pa'i 'khrungs dper/ da byid dkar po/ rdza skyes thod dkar/ bya rgod sug pa zer ba snang / da lta bya rgod sug pa ni 'dab ma sug lo 'dra ba la me tog snying zho sha'i rtsi gu'i dbyibs can gcig la byed 'dug go/yu mo mde'u 'byin ni/ srog chags kyis snyed (rnyedakyepa'i sman gyi nang nas sha bas snyed (rnyed1pa ste/ ri mtho sar skyes pa'i 'dab ma rgya men 'dra ba la me tog dkar ser byas pa zhig yong ba de yin pa 'dra ste/ da lta byin gnam lcags zil can lo ma phra sib me tog sngon po byas pa dang gcig par 'dod kyang / chos rje zur mkhar ba'i sngo sbyor du tha dad grangs snang ngo //dar ya kan zhes pa la 'jug yul mang yang / brgya byin gyis mdzad pa'i sman gyi 'khrungs dpe las/ 'dzam bu gling na skye bar dkon// dar ya kan zhes ming du grags// lo ma khrad po rtsa ba dkar// me tog dkar dang me tog dmar// me tog ser dang me tog sngo// bsil 'jam rdza las skyes pa yin//dkar po 'dra dang mi 'dra mang // re re la yang yon tan mang // spyi khyab sbyor lugs grogs dang ni// sna khrid lcag gis bsgyur ba na// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams sel// zhes pas/ me tog dkar dmar ser sngo bzhir phye ba dang /sgrol mas mdzad pa'i 'khrungs dper/ rma rnams grub ('drubakapa'i dar ya

༄༅/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 167kan// rma gsar dud bdug lo ma chang nang btsos// khong btang mcher pa'i nad rnams sel// ces dang / klu bdud nag po dar ya kan// brag la skye zhing kun na dkon// me tog dkar dmar ser sngo bzhi// gcig tu ma nges skyes pas 'byung // bsil 'jam rdza la skyes te yong // grogs ldan nad rigs thams cad 'joms// mchog tu rgya nad tshad pa sel// ces dang / brgya byin lhas gsungs dar yang kan// dar ya kan la rigs lnga yod// klung shod skyes pa'i dar ya kan// me tog dmar po lo ma sngo// kha gcig ha lo dmar po zer//ri snyan /gnyan1mgul skyes dar ya kan// me tog sngon po mdangs dang ldan//lo ma cung zad nya ga can// chu mig nang skyes dar ya kan// lo ma me tog sdong bo gsum// bre kha'i dbyibs dang 'dra ba yin// kha gcig chu 'dum zhes kyang zer// rigs lngar nges pa med pa ste// lo ma me tog dus su btus// zhib btags dar btsags dom mkhris dang // skyer shun srub ma sbyar ba yis//mgo chag rma la phye ma gdab// sbang ma dag gis phyi chas bya// khong du btang bas gsos pa mgyogs// rtsa chad 'khyoms dang klad ral 'tsho// chur btus tugadus1btang bas ma zhu sel// shing kun dang sbyar grang rlung sel// nyams chung pho ba'i me drod skyed// ces pas/ rma rnams 'drub pa'i dar ya kan// klu 'dul nag po dar ya kan// klungs shod skye ba'i dar ya kan// ri snyan (gnyan1mgul skyes dar ya kan// chu mig nang skyes dar ya kan lngar bshad nas/ klu 'dul nag po dar ya kan la me tog gis phye ba bzhir mdzad do// de yang rma rnams 'grub ('drub3pa'i dar ya kan ni rma sman gsang ba sman gcig ste/ bra bo'i lo ma 'dra ba la/ de las che zhing mdog sngo ba rkang phra la ring ba'o//klu 'dul nag po dar ya kan ni klu bdud rdo rje ste/ sdong bo mda' snyug 'dra ba tsher ma cung zad yod pa/ me tog dbyibs a byag tsher sngon 'dra ba la de bas che ba/ mdog dkar ser dmar sngo ba zhig yong bar 'dug rung cung sngon po

168 ༄7khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/mang ngo // klungs shod skye ba'i dar ya kan ni ha lo dmar po'o// ri snyan mgul skyes dar ya kan ni/ a byag tsher sngon no// chu mig nang skyes dar ya kan ni/ bre ga 'dra ba'i chu ldum par grags pa'o// 'dir 'ga' zhig brgya byin lhas gsungs dar ya kan la rigs lnga yod ces bstan pa'i don ma go bar zad do// dmu rdzing sel ba'i dar ya kan sga tig pa zhes grangs (bgrangakyepa ni/rigs lnga gong du smos par ma gtogs kyang / dar ya kan gyi tha snyan tusnyad3ni shin tu 'jug pas chu ser skabs su dar ya kan zhes byung na sga tig pa la go bar bya'o//rta lpags pa la/ ri'i rta lpags dang / klungs kyi rta lpags gnyis/dang po me tog dmar khra 'dab ma tsub gyong ste/ 'brog pa rkub phyis su grags pa'o// klungs kyi rta lpags ni/ me tog ser po 'dab ma spu med pa ste/ snga ma ri klungs gnyis ka la skye zhing / phyi ma ri la skye bar 'dug go/ ming me tog phreng ba/ mon mo khros kyi rdzing / ha hu pa pa/ khog tukha3shog pa zer ro//a bhi sha sman ngo gsal byed du gzhi la mdzad kyang / rang lugs lo ma ram ljang ba 'dra ba/ rtsa ba sgog sil 'dra ba me tog sngon po kha spub thur du 'phyang ba zhig yong ba la byed/ gzhi ni cu gang sgog sil ma ste/ rtsa ba'i rdog po zhib par snur la g.yag ru'i nang du blug la pra tshil gyis kha bsdams nas/dgun zla gsum chu'i nang du bcug ste ngar btags pa ni ga bur 'dul ba dang / glo'i nad la sogs cu gang nyid du nus pa mtshungs so//stag sha ni/ tshi dang dri che ba bzang ngo // spang rgyan dkar po zhes pa la/dkar sngo khra gsum gyi 'dir dkar po gzung la/ ma rnyed na khra bo dkar shas che ba yang rung ngo // doṇ+ḍat+pā pa la spang rgyan dkar po la 'jug go/yu gu shing ni/ bcad 'byor du yang 'dren/ ming rnam par ba/ glos ma/ phag ldang ba/ tre tre shing / rkang gtso pa rnams zer ro//

༄༅/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 169rtsad dang dgu thub ldum stag ces pa ni/ da lta rtsad su mi sman ser po 'jam dbyangs khros pa/ rtsad dang dgu thub glang chen chig thub ste ru bde/ldum stag go byi la ste bya 'phul tu'aphur1leb lajibyed pa mang bar snang rung / rje rang byung pas/ go byi la yis dug tshad sel// ldum stag glang chen de dang mtshungs// sha rkang bum pa a 'jong sngo// bya phul tu'aphurakasleb dang su mi sman// dpa' bo dkar ser dmar po gsum// 'di bcu dug tshad thams cad sel// ces gsungs pas/ go byi la/ ldum stag bya 'phul ('phur1leb gsum so sor grangs (bgrang3pas/ ldum stag ni ko ṭha la bya'o//a byag ni/ lha khongs gur gum ste/ ming me tog gur gum/ a byag gur gum/ a byag gzer 'joms/ tang tang mgo rnams zer ro//gser skud ni la kha tshor skye ba'i rtsa (rtswa1rta rnga'i rnam pa mdog ser ba'o//'di la ri tshos pa yang zer ro//tsher sngon ni a byag tsher sngon te/ da dha kyi zhes kyang zer/ kha gcig gnyan gzer skabs su a byag gzer 'joms dang / mgo chag skabs su tsher sngon gtong zer yang / nus pa rkyang sel 'dir ni/ a byag mgo chags tuchag1gso zhing chu ser skem// zhes pa dang / tsher sngon rus chags (chag3gso zhing lha ba 'degs// zhes gsungs pas/ gnyis ka mgo chag la bsngags par snang ngo //lug ru la/ dkar ser dmar sprug bzhi me tog gi kha dog gis phye/ming a dza shiṅgā zer/ se ba'i me tog gi ming ka na ka lha'i bu mo zer ro//'bu su hang la/ me tog dmar po dang / ser po gnyis/ me tog dmar po can 'bog sug pa zer/ ser po la sgang bu yod med gnyis/ sgang bu yod pa/ 'bu su hang yin la/ ming bi shu ka ni shi/ spri ka ni shu kasman le sgang bu/ gser gyi cod pan can zer/ sman ngo gsal byed du/ 'bu

170 ༄khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/su hang pho/ co ga klad sman mo/ sgang bu yod med kyis 'byed gsung ba snang bas sgang bu med pa 'bu su hang du bzhed pa 'dra/ 'ga' zhig sgang bu med pa co ga klad sman du byed pa dang / 'ga' zhig 'bu su hang dang co ga klad sman gcig par 'dod pa dang / 'ga' zhig co ga klad sman pa yag pa la 'dod pa byung yang rma dang glo nad sel bar ni phyogs mthun par snang / rang lugs co ga glad sman dang 'bu su hang gcig par 'dod do// sgong thog pa ni/ spe tog ser sgang 'bras phra/ dbyibs yungs kar 'dra ba ste/ ming ma btab skyes/ 'dre dpal/ 'dre mo yungs dkar/ phe la ka med/ 'dre dpal gangs (gang3rnams zer ro// sprel sman sangs rgyas dang 'di gnyis rigs gcig pa la nang khul dbye ba cung zhig yod do//a krong la/ rtsa a krong / mkhan pa a krong / shing a krong ste rgyus phye bas gsum/ dkar ser dmar ba me tog gis phye bas gsum/ glo nad la rtsa a krong bsngags/ glo gzer la 'og ma gsum bsngags pas skabs 'dir rtsa a krong bzang ngo //tshar bong la dkar nag gnyis las/ dkar po la 'brum bu thog rgod zer/ 'dir nag po ri logs dang zhing mu la skye ba phon par skye zhing dri ma dugs pa bzang ngo //tang kun ni lca ba'i rigs te/ lca ba la/ dkar nag rgod gsum gyi/'dir rgod lo ma lca ba gzhan las che ba dri dugs pa rtsa ba spos sbyor la 'gro ba nyid tang kun pa'o// —se rgod kha cig khu ru la byed kyang / rin chen 'khrungs dpe las/ se rgod ma zhes bya ba ni// srib mo nags kyi nang du skye// sdong bo khong stong shun pa smug/ me tog dmar po rtsa ba spun// 'bras bu che la rab tu dmar// rang gi nus pas dug nad 'joms// zhes gsungs pas khu ru'i 'bras bu ni srug la

༄7/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 171chen po rang mi yong bas a sri ra yang zer/ dom se zer ba 'di nyid do//shug pa tsher ma can shug pa lo ma la tsher ma yod pa ste/ ming g.yu 'brug ze ba zer/skyer ba'i me tog la/ ming ka ta ma puṣ+ṭha/ pa la ta la puṣ+ṭha/ da rdu ha ti puṣ+ṭha rnams zer ro// 'bru la khrag mdog ma zer/thang khrom pa ni dkar nag gnyis las 'dir dkar po ste/ spyi ming da dhu ra/ ka na ka punā rī ste gser gyi mdzis ma/ badz+ra ka na ka mkhun pa gros 'debs/ la gu khra 'gyed/ phan pa kun ldan zer ro//lang thang rtse la ming badz+ra bharga la zer/srin shing sna ma ni 'bu srin gnas pa'i shing dug can te dug kham mo//dkar po chig thub la 'jug yul mang yang dug gi skabs su rung ba de/gnyan srin gyi skabs su thang khrom dkar po'o//a ba la pho mo gnyis las pho me tog med pa dang / mo yod pa'o// gnyis ka yang brag la skyes pa'i dngul gyi mo khab 'dra ba bzang ngo // cung zad de bas sbom pa'i a 'dras kyang tshab ma rung ngo // gab tu dngul gyi mo khab can zer ro//pat+pa ta ni/ ming skra bzang zil ba can dang / rims 'joms zer ro//do ba la rgod g.yung gnyis/ ri la skyes pa rgod/ klungs la skyes pa g.yung / ming sa 'og bdud rtsi/ srin 'joms/ dbyar zhun/ ldum rgod/gab tu/ sngags btsun mar gyi rkyal ba can rnams zer ro//'dam bu ka ra ni/ rtsa 'dam bu ka ra ste/ yur ba sogs chu yod sar skye ba sdong bu khong stong 'dab ma tsong 'dra ba/ snye ma ram bu 'dra ba'i snyi ba/ ro mngar ba'o//'bri ta sa 'dzin ni/ 'bri ta sa 'dzin rgyu ma 'dra/ mdo mdor sa la

172 ༄7ོkhyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/'dzin cing 'brel// ces dang / byi rus thag pas sa gzhi khyab// ba thag dmar po rtsa rnams 'thud// ces gsungs pas/ sa 'dzin spun gsum ste/'bri ta sa 'dzin/ gro lo sa 'dzin/ tsi tsi sa 'dzin gsum las/ dang po ni/sa 'dre la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ bro (gro3lo ma la byed/ gsum pa ni/ tsi tsi ma zer ro// bya pho tsi tsi ni 'dod pa mang yang rang lugs tsi tsi ma la 'dod do//sho (shu3mo za ni grags pa ste/ ming mi thi zer/snyi ba ni shing gzhan la 'khril zhing skye/ rtsa ba dwa ba 'dra ba'i ro mngar ba me tog sngon po can yin la/ ming ku lu'am/ kyi lu zer/g.yer shing la/ rgod g.yung gnyis las/ rgod glo yul nas 'byung ba'i 'bras bu dmar nag ste g.yer mar grags pa 'byung ba'i shing ngo // g.yung zhing srub (sribs3su skye ba'i g.yer shing pa zhes 'bod pa'o// ming gzhan ma gzhogs gru bzhi zer ro// me tog gser chen ni 'dab khrad por skye ba 'od dang ldan pa/ me tog rta rmig pa'i me tog 'dra ba la nag po'i ra ri med pa 'od dang ldan pa'o//rta rmig pa ni lo ma rta mig 'dra ba me tog ser po nag po'i ra ri yod pa'o//brag skya ha bo ni/ brag la skye ba'i ut+pal gyi 'dam tu'adab3ma 'dra ba me tog dmar smug ste/ ming ming bo bdun gyi sring gcig ma zer ro//brag spus pa la/ gre gu gser thig thig khrab can/ dka' tuskyekab rgyun gcod/ gri gu rat+na/ btsun mo re ral/ gzig mjug pa/ gzig gi stod rlag can zer ro// 'dir mjug ma'i ming can gyi sman la/ rje rang byung bas/ sprel mjug dug tshad kun la phan// khyi mjug dngul chu'i dug gsod byed// gzig mjug mgo yi lha ba 'debs// stag mjug 'dus pa'i nad rnams sel// khyung 'jug rus tshad byer ba sdud// 'di bcu sbyar na dug kun phan// zhes gsungs pa la/ sprel mjug pa dug sman skabs su byi snyi ba ser po/

༄7/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 173khyi mjug pa byi snyi ba sngon po/ gzig mjug pa dug sman skabs su lding ba sngon po/ rma'i skabs su gre khubre3gu gser thig tshad pa'i skabs su sdong bo mda' tsam la lo ma bra bo'i lo ma 'dra ba la de bas che ba brtsegs ma yod pa rtse mor snye ma sngon po yod pa zhig go/ stag mjug pa lding ba ser po/ khyung mjug pa 'dab ma rta lpags pa 'dra ba de bas chung ba brtsegs ma yod pa/ me tog dkar dri dug (dugs3pa zhig go/rgya spos ni 'bu su hang gi skye lugs 'dra ba la de bas ring zhing 'dab ma che ba me tog ser po can dri shin tu che ba'o//spang spos la ming ni dza ṭa mam (mi3si/ dza ṭi la ma si/ pa ṣa na da/ dri chen thod dmar/ kudha rnams zer ro/myang rtsi spras ni/ rtsa ba nang ser phyi gla sgang 'dra ba'i sbu can khu bas ser tshos dang dpe cha'i thig yong ba kong smad nas 'byung ba de yin no// rin chen gter spungs las/ myang rtsi spras dang khrag rkang gcig/ ces pa ser po khrag rkang yang zer ro//rgu drus ni ser po rgu drus so//'bam po ni/ g.ya' spang rdza gseb skye/ sdong bo khong stong lo ma go snyod 'dra ba la dri ma dug tudugs1pa zhig ste/ me tog med pa pho rigs dang /yod pa mo rigs so//me tog lug mig ces pa la/ lug mig pa/ lug chung ba/ lug ngal ba/lug mig nag po/ ser po dang lnga/ lug mig nag po ni/ 'dab ma phrad po sngon po ze'u 'bru ser po mtha' nag po'i 'byed yod pa'o// lug chung ba ni/gong las chung ba 'dab ma sngo skya ze'u 'bru ser skya 'byed med pa'o// lug ngal ba ni/ yan lag du ma gyes pa me tog lug chung ba 'dra ba'o// lug mig nag po ni/ 'dab ma sngo nag se'u 'bru mthing nag mtha' la nag po'i 'byed yod

174 ༄7khyud bzhi'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/pa ste/ rgyal ba'i spyan can zer zhing / ming can nag po 'jug pa'i skabs kyang yod do// lug mig ser po ni/ ze'u 'bru bur kha mig tshem tshem yod pa 'dab ma med pa ste/ dbang phyug mig zer zhing / a phyag (byag1gzer 'joms kyi rigs su byed do// spyi ming ārma gu ta rang sbed/ me ṣa bi lo tsa/brda rnying dra kha sral dre'u rnams zer ro//mkhan pa la dkar/ nag dmar/ a krong dang bzhi/ dang po ni/mkhan dkar lo ma dang sdong bo skya ba ral ba cung zad yod pa dri zhim pa'o//'di la ming zor ba/ khrag gcod ral ba/ khi ra ta/ na wīn/ mkhan skya/rgya nag skad du ze'u wang ti zer/ sman ngo gsal byed du sprel mjug 'jug pa'i skabs yod par mdzad snang / bra h+ma mū la mkhan dkar dang / bar+bha karko ṭī mkhan pa 'bras bu med par bshad do// nag po ni/ 'dab ma snga ma las rag pa/ mdog sngo nag ral ba med pa dri che la dugs pa'o// dmar po ni/'dab ma dbyibs nag po dang 'dra ba las rtse khrad pa mdog gzhi sngo ser la dmar mdangs cung zad yod pa'o// a krong ni sngar bshad pa bzhin no//chu ma rtsi ni/ bya dkar gdang bzhugs 'dra zhes pa la bsten (brten1nas chu 'gram du skye ba'i sngo me tog dmar po sgang bu'i nang du 'bru dkar po gshibs pa zhig la 'dod pa byung na'ang / bcud phud yang zer/ mkha' 'gro la phug yang zer/ bcas la ram bur grags pa'o//byi tsher la/ thibs sangs/ rims sel/ gnyid 'joms zer/de wa la/ rtsa/ sngo/ shing gsum gyi/ rtsa ni rtsa rna tso'i mgrin pa 'dra ba sbang na khu ba sngon por 'bab pa zhig yod par grags pa'o// sngo la/ sngon mo chab 'dren gyi mkha' 'gro gsang sman la byed pa dang / thing du me tog lang /sngo sman mthing mdog yang zer ba'i ston kha spang dang g.ya' ri sogs gang skyes su sa gzhi sngon por gtong ba la byed pa gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma bzang ngo /

༄༅/sa bcad drug pa/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes bstan pa/ 175shing ni spyi zhur du grags pa ste/ 'dir sngo bzang ngo //re ral la/ rgyal po re ral/ btsun mo re ral/ blon po re ral dang gsum/ dang po ni sa skyes bya pho kro kro/ gnyis pa ni brag spos pa/ gsum pa ni be skyes re ral la/ be ljang bdud rtsi/ ngur mo 'bri lce/ hang 'bag la(pa3/ gtsang (rtsa1lag pa/ gtsangs turtsangs1pa ral gri/ be+e la gzhon pa'i btsun chung rnams zer/ ldum bu re ral la kha cig be skyes re ral la byed kyang /rang lugs skye bya pho kro kro la byed/zhum (zhu3mkhan ni/ seng phrom ste rgod g.yung gnyis las/ lo ma 'thug cing ser tshos btub pa rgod/ lo ma srab 'jam phra ba g.yung ngo // ming ni bṛ ha ba tra/ kra mu ka sa ru(duka/ pa ri ṣa/ gan la/ sgeg (skags3grogs/brgya byin zer/tshos ni rgya tshos te/ dro tshos dang nag hrug gnyis/ snga ma tshos sogs la nus pa chung la phyi ma bzang / ming la k+ṣa/ dzā ru/ la hi ta/ kri mi dza/ yul skad du la he/ li ti/ lha mo'i zla mtshan/ kong shu/ srin bu'i khrag khyab 'jug ril ma zer/ brtsod (btsod1la ming gzhan/ mañdzi ṣ+ṭha/ rak+ta/ ta mra mū la/ ta mra/ mdog bsgyur zer/ rasna zhes pa brtsod tubatsod3bye brag pa zhig be|/lcam pa la pho rigs ha lo/ mo rigs rgya lcam pa/ ma ning gar yang skye ba gsum las 'dir ma ning bzang / ming 'bras bu a dza (dzha1ga lo ma la nyi dga'/ sa tang yo/ lcam pa lha mo/ a rga(rka1/ so ma wa rtsa/ smur+ya bhat+ta (baghi1ste nyi dga' 'am nyi ma gus rnams zer ro// brag lcam ni/ brag la skyes pa'i lo ma lcam pa 'dra ba de bas chung zhing 'thung (thung1ba me tog dkar chung zhig beko/bra ma'i rtsa ba ni/ gram gle la skye ba'i shing ste de'i rtsa ba'o//

༄༅ṣe'u dang po/ rgyud kyi mjug don bsdu ba bstan pa/ 233gzhan las/ khyung sder dkar sprug gnyis/ dgu thub/ rtsad/ yug gu shing /ga ga (gang gākachung / spang brgyan(rgyanaka/ spang spos/ 'om bu/ spang rtsi/go snyod/ stag sha ba/ ser (sekargod/ skyer shun/ a bo/ rtsod (btsod1rnam (rnams1thun re re zhes 'byung ngo // tsha ba spyi bcos kyi sman ni/ ga bur/tsan dan/ 'aghi hang gsum/ rgyas par sbyor na sman sogs 'bring du sbyor na gong gi sman gsum gyi steng du/ mi sha dang / 'chin (mchin3pa ra mchin zhes 'byung ngo // tshig lhag ma rnam (rnams1go sla'o// yang lugs gzhan ston pa ni/char nyung 'bras bu gsum dang rtsa ba lnga// gtso bo drug la sman mar tshul bzhin bya// de la gong sman phye bya kha tshar bdab(gdabaka/ / dngarasnadang sbyar la ston zla tha chung btang // zad kha'i dri chen dri chu bar pa gnyis// mkhar bzhong (gzhong1nang du chos sman gsum sbyar la// ras gtsang snod blug mkhan gseb zhag gsum sbrul(bsrul3/ / grib lhag (lhags1skam phye thun bdun chang gis dbul// dug rigs ma lus ma shi bar du thub// ces pa mchan rnying las char nyung bzhi cha/ 'bras gsum gyi a ru ra bcu/ ba ru ra dang skyu ru ra lnga lnga rtsa ba lnga bzhi cha zhes 'byung ba'i bzhi cha ni/ a ru ra'i bzhi cha yin par sems so//gtso bo drug ces pa ni skyu ru ra bcu gcig re ral/ yu gu shing / 'u su/hong len/ tig ta rnam (rnams3bzhi cha re/ zhes 'byung ba'i/ skyu ru gtso bo'i sman du byas/ gzhan drug po de'i bzhi cha re yin par sems so// dngar dang sbyar ba ni dngar gsum mam dngar gsum gang rung ngo // lag len gyi cha ni/ ston zla tha chung zhes pa ston zla tha chung gi tshes gcig nas tshes bdun bar/nang re la thun re chang gis phul btang / sman rdzogs khar dri chen dri chu khyor ba re btang / mkhar gzhong nang du tsan dan dkar po'i skya bas dkrugs la gong gi sman dang sbyar ba de/ ras gtsang du blug la/ mkhan pa 'bras bu dro ba'i gseb tu/ zhag gsum bsrul/ grib lhags la skam dgos zhes pa'o// tshig

234 ༄7gongs gtad rgyud kyi 'grel chen/lhag ma rnam (rnams1ni go sla'o// kun la zas dang spyod lam 'jig rtsi bsrungs// nad dang sbyor ba 'jig rtsi byung na skyar(bskyar1// du ba rlangs pa rims dri sna nas 'jug / de phyir kun la khyapa pa'i rtsa sgo srungs// ga bur dri chu bcong (cong3zhi lag 'thil tumathil1sbyar// nang ma bdun du snar rngub de rjes la 'dza ti gur gum na (nā1ga ge sar dang spang brgyan turgyan3tsan dan dmar po'i du bas bdug khyod (khegs1rtags mgo 'du tulus3lci 'dar khrum zer (phrum ser3khyer// dug gdon rims rnam skyornams3bsrungs pa'i mchog tu bshad// ba spu'i sgo srungs tsan dan khu ba dang // zo mar rtsi mar shing dngar mi tshil rnams bsdus khu drod ma yal ba'i nang dag tu/ 'dza ti gur gum bla tugla3rtsi spang spos dang / spang brgyan (rgyan3sbyar la lus kun dkrus tubakrus1rjes byug/ yang na bla tugla3rtsi phag tshil sbrul sha dang // sdig srin mu zi ra khrag bse mar khu// yang na ga bur bsil gsum tsan dan dang //bla tugla3rtsi chos sman phag tshil ra thug(byug) / ba spu'i sgo 'gegs lus sbrid lci ba yin// reg pa gsum gyi zer rlangs nyam mi nga // zhes so// zhes pa'i kun la zas dang spyod lam 'jig rtsi bsrungs// zhes pa'i don/ bsrungs pa gang la yang / 'ji ('jig3rtsi bsrungs pa ni mchan rnying las/ phag sha nya sha sgog pa klad pa/ sha'i smen(min3/ gro sran chang skyur rnams bsrungs/ spyod lam ni/ rngul thon pa'i las dang chur 'jug pa spong / nad dang sbyar ba 'jig rtsi byung na skyar(bskyar1/ zhes pa'i don bshal skyugs drag po byas pa/khrag zags pa rma bya'i sgo tusgro3dang / sbrul/ bya mtshal lu'i klad pa/ nya'i shabya mo nag mo'i sha sgo nga'i ser thig zos pa rnams byung na bsrungs pa skyar (bskyar1dgos/ du ba rlangs pa rims dri snang bas tusna nas1'jug / ces pa'i don/ du ba la bskur ba'i rdzi dug dang / rlangs dug rims kyis sna nas 'jug nas sna phug tu gong du gsungs pa'i du bas bdug pa sogs kyi kun tu

༄7ṣe'u dang po/ rgyud kyi mjug don bsdu ba bstan pa/ 235rgyal bas sna sgo bsrungs par bya ste/ gzhung las/ ga bur dri chu bcong (cong3zhi la 'thil (lag mthil3sbyar// nang ma bdun du sna re (rngub )rjes la//'dza ti gur gum na (nā1ga ge sar dang // spang brgyan (rgyanakatsan dan dmar po'i du ba bdug / ces pa ste go sla'o// rtsa sgo khyegs (khegs1pa'i rtags ni/gzhung las/ khyegs khukhegs3rtags lus lci 'dar dang khrum zer (phrum serakyekhyer// dug gdon rims rnams bsrungs pa'i mchog tu bshad// zhes pa'o//ba spu sogs kyi sgo bsrungs pa ni/ gzhung las/ ba spu'i sgo bsrungs tsan dan mar khu dang // zo mar rtsi mar shing dngar mi tshol tutshil3rnams// bsdus khu drod la yal ba'i nang dag tu// 'dza ti/ gur gum bla tugla1rtsi spang spos dang //spang brgyan (rgyan3sbyar la lus kun dkrus (bkrus3rjes byug / ces dang /yang bsrungs lugs gcig la/ yang na bla (gla3rtsi phag tshil sbrul sha dang //sdig srin mu zi ra khrag gso (bse1mar khu(khuraka// yang na ga bur bsil (gsum )tsan dan dang // bla (gla3rtsi chos sman phag tshil ra khrag byug / ba spu'i sgo 'gegs lus sbrid lci ba yin// reg pa nyi zer rlangs kyi nyams (nyamakyemi nga // zhes so// zhes pa'i gso (bsekyemar khu zhes pa gso skyibase1zho'i 'bru'i mar khu ni min te/ lus la byugs na rma ru 'gro ba'i phyir/ gzhan gang yin rtag (brtagakapar bya zhing / tshig gzhan rnam (rnams1ni go sla'o//bzhi pa/ rgyud 'dir ma 'dus pa'i gso dpyad gzhan yod med zhu ba/zhus lan bzhi pa ston pa ni/ de nas drang srong yid la khulas3skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so| kyai drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags/ rgyud

236 ༄7gongs gtad rgyud kyi 'grel chen/'dir ma tshang gso spyad (dpyad1mi 'dog (bdog3pa// zhes zhus pa'i zhu ba'o// lan ni/ de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa/ bde gshegs rnams kyi sprul pa'i 'gro don du// rgya gar yul du sman gyi sbyor ba gsungs// rgya nag yul du me rtsa (btsa'3rtsa sbyongs gsungs// dol po'i yul du gtar kha gtso bor gsungs// bod kyi yul du rtsa chu rtag (brtag3pa stanakhubastan1/ /lha yi 'khor la gso dpyad 'bum pa gsungs// drang srong 'khor la tsa ra ka sde brgyad// mu stegs 'khor la dbang phyug chen po'i rgyud// nang pa'i 'khor la rigs gsum mgon po'i rgyud// gso spyad (dpyad3rgyud 'di thams cad 'dus par stan(bstan1/ / 'dir ma 'dus pa'i gso spyad (dpyad3gzhan med de// 'phags pa'i thugs rjes phyogs rigs turis3 med mod kyang //gang zag mos pa'i mthong snang so sor shar// dper na mkha' la zla ba gcig shar ba// chu'i skyogs re turer3zla re shar ba bzhin// gcig tu gsungs kyang du mar so sor go / zhes pa rnams kyi don/ gang la gang 'tshams kyi chos gsungs pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sprul don mdzad de rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du sman gyi sbyor ba dang / rgya nag tu me rtsa (btsa'3dang rtsa sbyongs/ dol por gtar kha/ bod du rtsa chu rtag (brtag1pa rnams gtso bor gsungs shing /lha'i 'khor la gso spyad (dpyad3'bum pa dang / drang srong 'khor la rtsa ka (tsa rakaka sde brgyad/ mu stegs pa rnams la dbang phyug gi rgyud dang / nang pa'i 'khor la rigs gsum mgon po'i gso spyad (dpyad1kyi skor gsungs par snang yang / gso spyad (dpyad1'di de dag gi don gtso che ba rnam (rnams3ma 'dus pa med ces pa'o// gsungs gcig nyid du gsungs mod kyang du ma nyid du so sor go zhes pa ltar 'phags pa'i thugs rje la phyogs rigs turis1med pas/ nges pa'i don kho na gsungs kyang gdul bya rnams kyis so sor go zhes te/ tshig lhag ma rnams ni go sla'o// le'u'i mtshan ni/

༄7khe'u dang po/ rgyud kyi mjug don bsdu ba bstan pa/ 237bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las/ rgyud bzhi 'jug (mjug3bsdud (bsdu1ba'i le'u dang po zhes pa'o// skabs 'dir le'u nyer drug ces 'byung ba ni/ phyi ma rgyud gsungs pa/ de nas yongs gtad rgyud gsungs pa'i 'grel sgrigs nas bris pa 'dra na'ang / rtsa rgyud gsungs pa de nas bshad rgyud gsungs par bshad pas/ rgyud de gnyis kyang le'u'i grangs phyogs gcig tu 'gro dgos par gsungs par 'gyur te ha cang thal lo// de nas 'di ni 'jug (mjug1don yongs su btad tugatad1pa'i rgyu (rgyud3yin pas le'u gnyis su rig par bya'o//

238le'u gnyis pa/ rgyud kyi yongs gtad bstan pa/dang po/ gso rig sman gyi dgos pa zhu ba/de nas le'u gnyis pa bshad par bya ste/ de la yang / zhu ba dang zhus lan gnyis las/ zhu ba rnam lnga'i zhu ba dang po ni/ de nas drang srong yid la (las1skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kyai drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags/ dang po nad shugs ma rdzogs sngon tshul du(dus3/ / gso ba byas kyang lam nas mi zlog cing // bar du nad rgyas snyen (gnyen3pos 'phral mi choms/tha mar yan lag bcu gnyis ldan gyur kyang // nad las mi grol srog ni zad par snang // gzhan dag de las go zlog (ldog1'gyur ba'i phyir// gso rig sman gyis dgos pa ci zhig bya// mtsho ('tsho3mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos the tshom gsol// zhes pa ste/ de la dang po/ nad shugs ma rdzogs sngon tshul du(dus3/ / gso ba byas kyang lam nas mi zlog cing // zhes pa'i don/ dang po nad shugs ma rdzogs pa la sngon tshul du (dus1gso ba byas kyang lam nas mi zlog cing / zhes so// bar du nad rgyas snyen (gnyenanapos 'phral mi chom(choms1/ / zhes pa'i don/ bar du nad legs par rgyas pa snyen (gnyen1pos 'phral la mi tshom (choms3/ zhes so// tha mar yan lag bcu gnyis ldan gyur pas// nad las mi grol srog ni zad par snang // zhes pa'i don/ bcos pa'i tha ma rlung 'khris (mkhris1bad kan 'dus pa dang bzhi po re re yang /thog mtha' bar gsum gong bzhin sbyar ba'i yan lag bcu gnyis ldan par

༄zalde'u gnyis pa/ rgyud kyi yongs gtad bstan pa/ 239gyur pas nad las mi grol zhing / srog ni zad par snang zhes pa'o// gzhan dag de las go zlog (ldog3'gyur ba'itshophyir| gso rig sman gyis dgos pa ci zhig bya// zhes pa'i don/ gzhan dag bcos tshul de la go zlog (ldog1kyang mi phan par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gso rig sman gyi dgos pa ci zhig bya zhes zhus pa'o// de'i lan ston pa ni/ ston pa rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so// drang srong chen po de la rtog mi 'tshal// nad la bzhi brgya rtsa bzhir grags pa la// brgya dang rtsa gcig ltar snang 'phral gyi nad// ma bcos rang dgar bzhag pa'i tupas3mtsho ('tsho1ba yod// 'os ('on3kyang bcos na myur du bde bar ster// dper na 'gyel 'bub (bub3lag nas 'then pa 'dra// dang po mngon tshul che bror byung gyur nas// ma bcos rang dgar lam nas bzlog pa yod// dper na mkha' la sprin 'bebs ('thibs3char 'bab pa// slo tuglo3bur sang (sangasakanas than par 'gyur ba 'dra// brgya dang rtsa gcig kun rtags (brtags3gdon yin pas// de ma bcos par sman dpyad len mi 'dod// gdon bcos sman med gyur kyang mtsho ('tsho1 ba yod//dper na dpung ba g.yar ba'i btson bu 'dra// brgya dang rtsa gcig yong tuyongs3grub tshe yi nad// ma bcos 'chi la bcos na mtsho tu'atsho3ba yod//ces pa'i don/ drang srong chen po zhes nas/ nad de las mi grol zhes rtogs (rtog3mi 'tshal te/ nad la bzhi brgya rtsa bzhir grags pa la/ brgya dang rtsa gcig ni ltar snang 'phral gyi nad yin pas/ ma bcos rang dgar bzhag pas mtsho ('tsho3ba yod la/ 'on kyang bcos na bde bar go skabs yod do// yang brgya dang rtsa gcig kun rtags (brtags1gdon gyi nad yin pas/ gdon de ma bcos par sman spyad tudapyad1kyi kha len mi 'dod kyang / gdon bcos sman med par gyur kyang myur du mtsho ('tsho3ba yod/ gzhan yang / brgya dang rtsa gcig ni yongs grub tshe yi nad ces bya ste/ ma bcos na 'chi la bcos na
